1	"""Deterministic Markdown rendering for Things task snapshots."""
2	
3	import re
4	from typing import Sequence
5	
6	from .models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
7	
8	GENERATED_MARKER = "<!-- generated-by: things3-github-sync; do not edit -->"
9	
10	_STATUS_MARKERS = {
11	    "incomplete": " ",
12	    "completed": "x",
13	    "canceled": "-",
14	}
15	_INLINE_SPECIALS = "\\`*_[]<>"
16	
17	
18	def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
19	    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
20	    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
21	    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
22	    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
23	    escaped = []
24	    for character in normalized:
25	        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
26	            escaped.append("\\")
27	        escaped.append(character)
28	    return "".join(escaped)
29	
30	
31	def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
32	    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
33	
34	
35	def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
36	    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
37	
38	
39	def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
40	    rendered = []
41	    for tag in tags:
42	        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
43	        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
44	        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
45	    return " ".join(rendered)
46	
47	
48	def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
49	    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
50	    lines = normalized.split("\n")
51	    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
52	        lines.pop()
53	    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
54	        return ()
55	    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
56	
57	
58	def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
59	    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
60	    if item.stop_date:
61	        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
62	    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
63	
64	
65	def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
66	    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
67	    lines = [
68	        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
69	        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
70	    ]
71	
72	    fields = (
73	        ("创建时间", task.created),
74	        ("修改时间", task.modified),
75	        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
76	        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
77	        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
78	        ("项目", task.project_title),
79	        ("领域", task.area_title),
80	        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
81	    )
82	    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
83	
84	    if task.tags:
85	        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
86	
87	    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
88	    if note_lines:
89	        lines.append("- **备注**:")
90	        lines.extend(note_lines)
91	
92	    if task.checklist:
93	        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
94	        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
95	
96	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
97	
98	
99	def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
100	    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
101	    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
102	    if not tasks:
103	        return header
104	
105	    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
106	    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"
107	
108	
109	def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
110	    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
111	    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
112	    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER

22	    file_handler = RotatingFileHandler(log_dir / "sync.log", maxBytes=max_bytes, backupCount=backup_count, encoding="utf-8")
23	    stream_handler = logging.StreamHandler()

+"""Pure, deterministic rendering of Things snapshots into Markdown documents."""
+
+import logging
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Dict, Iterable, List, Sequence, Set, Tuple
+
+from .markdown import render_document
+from .models import ContainerPath, ContainerSnapshot, RenderedSnapshot, TaskSnapshot, ThingsSnapshot
+from .utils import sanitize_path_segment
+
+
+_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+_ROOT_FILES = (
+    (Path("Inbox.md"), "Inbox"),
+    (Path("Today.md"), "Today"),
+    (Path("Anytime.md"), "Anytime"),
+    (Path("Someday.md"), "Someday"),
+    (Path("Upcoming.md"), "Upcoming"),
+    (Path("已完成.md"), "已完成"),
+    (Path("已取消.md"), "已取消"),
+)
+_CONTAINER_FILES = (
+    ("tasks.md", "任务"),
+    ("已完成.md", "已完成"),
+    ("已取消.md", "已取消"),
+)
+_VALID_STARTS = {"Inbox", "Anytime", "Someday"}
+_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH = 120
+
+
+def _container_sort_key(container: ContainerSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, str]:
+    return (container.title.casefold(), container.uuid)
+
+
+def _suffix_segment(base: str, uuid: str, length: int) -> str:
+    suffix = "-" + uuid[:length]
+    available = _MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH - len(suffix)
+    if available <= 0:
+        return uuid[:_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH]
+    return base[:available].rstrip(".").strip() + suffix
+
+
+def _unique_suffix_lengths(containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], needs_suffix: Set[str]) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    """Return UUID prefix lengths that distinguish suffixed peers."""
+    lengths = {container.uuid: min(8, len(container.uuid)) for container in containers if container.uuid in needs_suffix}
+    while True:
+        groups: Dict[Tuple[str, str], List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
+        for container in containers:
+            if container.uuid not in needs_suffix:
+                continue
+            key = (bases[container.uuid].casefold(), container.uuid[:lengths[container.uuid]].casefold())
+            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(container)
+        duplicates = [group for group in groups.values() if len(group) > 1]
+        if not duplicates:
+            return lengths
+        changed = False
+        for group in duplicates:
+            for container in group:
+                current = lengths[container.uuid]
+                if current < len(container.uuid):
+                    lengths[container.uuid] = current + 1
+                    changed = True
+        if not changed:
+            # UUIDs are unique, so this is defensive only for non-standard inputs.
+            return lengths
+
+
+def _allocate_kind(containers: Iterable[ContainerSnapshot], kind: str, root: str) -> List[ContainerPath]:
+    active = sorted(
+        (container for container in containers if not container.trashed),
+        key=_container_sort_key,
+    )
+    bases = {
+        container.uuid: sanitize_path_segment(container.title, "{}-{}".format(kind, container.uuid[:8]))
+        for container in active
+    }
+    needs_suffix: Set[str] = set()
+
+    # A case-insensitive duplicate cannot retain either clean segment.
+    by_clean_name: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
+    for container in active:
+        by_clean_name.setdefault(bases[container.uuid].casefold(), []).append(container)
+    for group in by_clean_name.values():
+        if len(group) > 1:
+            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
+
+    # A generated suffix can naturally be another container title.  Mark every
+    # conflicting path for suffixing, then repeat until all candidates are unique.
+    while True:
+        lengths = _unique_suffix_lengths(active, bases, needs_suffix)
+        candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
+        for container in active:
+            segment = (
+                _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
+                if container.uuid in needs_suffix
+                else bases[container.uuid]
+            )
+            candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
+        conflicts = [group for group in candidates.values() if len(group) > 1]
+        if not conflicts:
+            break
+        previous_count = len(needs_suffix)
+        for group in conflicts:
+            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
+        if len(needs_suffix) == previous_count:
+            # The lengths are already extended as far as needed for normal UUIDs.
+            break
+
+    paths = []
+    for container in active:
+        segment = (
+            _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
+            if container.uuid in needs_suffix
+            else bases[container.uuid]
+        )
+        paths.append(ContainerPath(container.uuid, kind, Path(root) / segment))
+    return paths
+
+
+def allocate_container_paths(
+    projects: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], areas: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot]
+) -> Tuple[ContainerPath, ...]:
+    """Allocate safe relative directories for active projects and areas."""
+    paths = _allocate_kind(projects, "project", "Projects")
+    paths.extend(_allocate_kind(areas, "area", "Areas"))
+    return tuple(sorted(paths, key=lambda item: (item.kind, item.relative_dir.as_posix().casefold(), item.uuid)))
+
+
+def _primary_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[int, str, str, str]:
+    return (task.index, task.created or "", task.title.casefold(), task.uuid)
+
+
+def _descending_text(value: str) -> str:
+    return "".join(chr(0x10FFFF - ord(character)) for character in value)
+
+
+def _terminal_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, int, str, str, str]:
+    return (_descending_text(task.stop_date or ""),) + _primary_sort_key(task)
+
+
+def _document_title(path: Path, suffix: str) -> str:
+    if len(path.parts) == 1:
+        return suffix
+    return " / ".join(path.parts[:-1]) + " / " + suffix
+
+
+def _primary_file(
+    task: TaskSnapshot,
+    project_paths: Dict[str, Path],
+    area_paths: Dict[str, Path],
+) -> Path:
+    base = project_paths.get(task.project_uuid or "")
+    if base is None:
+        base = area_paths.get(task.area_uuid or "")
+    if task.status == "completed":
+        return base / "已完成.md" if base else Path("已完成.md")
+    if task.status == "canceled":
+        return base / "已取消.md" if base else Path("已取消.md")
+    if base:
+        return base / "tasks.md"
+    if task.start not in _VALID_STARTS:
+        _LOG.warning("Incomplete task %s has invalid or missing start %r; routing to Anytime", task.uuid, task.start)
+        return Path("Anytime.md")
+    return Path(task.start + ".md")
+
+
+def _dynamic_tasks(
+    uuids: Sequence[str], tasks: Dict[str, TaskSnapshot], warned: Set[str]
+) -> List[TaskSnapshot]:
+    selected = []
+    for uuid in uuids:
+        task = tasks.get(uuid)
+        if task is None:
+            if uuid not in warned:
+                _LOG.warning("Dynamic view references missing task UUID %s", uuid)
+                warned.add(uuid)
+            continue
+        selected.append(task)
+    return selected
+
+
+def render_snapshot(snapshot: ThingsSnapshot) -> RenderedSnapshot:
+    """Render an immutable, entirely in-memory representation of a snapshot."""
+    containers = allocate_container_paths(snapshot.projects, snapshot.areas)
+    project_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "project"}
+    area_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "area"}
+    active_tasks = tuple(task for task in snapshot.tasks if not task.trashed)
+
+    tasks_by_file: Dict[Path, List[TaskSnapshot]] = {path: [] for path, _ in _ROOT_FILES}
+    titles: Dict[Path, str] = {path: title for path, title in _ROOT_FILES}
+    for container in containers:
+        for filename, suffix in _CONTAINER_FILES:
+            path = container.relative_dir / filename
+            tasks_by_file[path] = []
+            titles[path] = _document_title(path, suffix)
+
+    for task in active_tasks:
+        tasks_by_file[_primary_file(task, project_paths, area_paths)].append(task)
+
+    for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items():
+        if path.name in {"已完成.md", "已取消.md"}:
+            tasks.sort(key=_terminal_sort_key)
+        else:
+            tasks.sort(key=_primary_sort_key)
+
+    active_by_uuid = {task.uuid: task for task in active_tasks}
+    warned_missing: Set[str] = set()
+    tasks_by_file[Path("Today.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.today_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
+    tasks_by_file[Path("Upcoming.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.upcoming_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
+
+    files = {path: render_document(titles[path], tasks) for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items()}
+    return RenderedSnapshot(files=files, containers=containers)

1	"""Deterministic Markdown rendering for Things task snapshots."""
2	
3	import re
4	from typing import Sequence
5	
6	from .models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
7	
8	GENERATED_MARKER = "<!-- generated-by: things3-github-sync; do not edit -->"
9	
10	_STATUS_MARKERS = {
11	    "incomplete": " ",
12	    "completed": "x",
13	    "canceled": "-",
14	}
15	_INLINE_SPECIALS = "\\`*_[]<>"
16	
17	
18	def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
19	    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
20	    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
21	    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
22	    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
23	    escaped = []
24	    for character in normalized:
25	        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
26	            escaped.append("\\")
27	        escaped.append(character)
28	    return "".join(escaped)
29	
30	
31	def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
32	    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
33	
34	
35	def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
36	    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
37	
38	
39	def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
40	    rendered = []
41	    for tag in tags:
42	        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
43	        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
44	        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
45	    return " ".join(rendered)
46	
47	
48	def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
49	    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
50	    lines = normalized.split("\n")
51	    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
52	        lines.pop()
53	    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
54	        return ()
55	    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
56	
57	
58	def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
59	    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
60	    if item.stop_date:
61	        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
62	    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
63	
64	
65	def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
66	    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
67	    lines = [
68	        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
69	        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
70	    ]
71	
72	    fields = (
73	        ("创建时间", task.created),
74	        ("修改时间", task.modified),
75	        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
76	        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
77	        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
78	        ("项目", task.project_title),
79	        ("领域", task.area_title),
80	        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
81	    )
82	    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
83	
84	    if task.tags:
85	        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
86	
87	    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
88	    if note_lines:
89	        lines.append("- **备注**:")
90	        lines.extend(note_lines)
91	
92	    if task.checklist:
93	        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
94	        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
95	
96	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
97	
98	
99	def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
100	    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
101	    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
102	    if not tasks:
103	        return header
104	
105	    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
106	    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"
107	
108	
109	def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
110	    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
111	    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
112	    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER
113

5	
6	_INVALID_PATH_CHARS = re.compile(r'[/:?*<>|"\x00-\x1f]')
7	
8	def parse_bool(name: str, raw: str) -> bool:
9	    value = raw.strip().lower()
10	    if value in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}: return True
11	    if value in {"0", "false", "no", "off"}: return False
12	    raise ValueError(f"{name} must be true or false")
13	
14	def sanitize_path_segment(title: str, fallback: str, max_length: int = 120) -> str:
15	    value = _INVALID_PATH_CHARS.sub("-", title).strip().rstrip(".").strip()
16	    value = value or fallback
17	    return value[:max_length].rstrip(".").strip() or fallback[:max_length]
18	
19	def setup_logging(log_dir: Path, level: str, max_bytes: int, backup_count: int) -> None:
20	    log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
21	    formatter = logging.Formatter("%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
22	    file_handler = RotatingFileHandler(log_dir / "sync.log", maxBytes=max_bytes, backupCount=backup_count, encoding="utf-8")
23	    stream_handler = logging.StreamHandler()
24	    file_handler.setFormatter(formatter); stream_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
25	    logging.basicConfig(level=getattr(logging, level.upper()), handlers=[file_handler, stream_handler], force=True)

12	### Important — collision resolution can emit duplicate container paths
13	
14	- **Location:** `src/renderer.py:105-115`
15	- **Failure scenario:** Two active containers have different UUIDs differing only by case (for example `AAAAAAAA` and `aaaaaaaa`) and titles that collide case-insensitively (for example `Release` and `release`). `_unique_suffix_lengths()` compares UUID prefixes with `.casefold()`. Once both prefixes have reached the full UUID length, it returns identical case-folded suffixes. The outer loop detects the collision, but since both members already have suffixes, `needs_suffix` does not grow and line 107 breaks. Both containers are then returned with the same case-insensitive path, so their generated documents overwrite one another in the `files` mapping.
16	- **Narrow remedy:** Make the disambiguator unique under the target filesystem comparison rule even for UUIDs that are equal case-insensitively. For example, retain an explicitly deterministic ordinal derived from the sorted collision group when full case-folded UUID prefixes still collide, and include it in the segment while preserving the 120-character limit. Continue collision resolution until every candidate `casefold()` path is unique rather than breaking with a collision.

It does not cover UUIDs that are distinct Python strings yet case-insensitively identical, which exposes the duplicate-path behavior above. Regression tests stay green while one container’s three documents disappear from `RenderedSnapshot.files`.
22	- **Narrow remedy:** Add a focused path-allocation test using `AAAAAAAA` and `aaaaaaaa` with case-colliding titles; assert unique `relative_dir.as_posix().casefold()` values and that rendering produces three documents for each container.

36	    suffix = "-" + uuid[:length]
37	    available = _MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH - len(suffix)
38	    if available <= 0:
39	        return uuid[:_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH]
40	    return base[:available].rstrip(".").strip() + suffix

43	def _unique_suffix_lengths(containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], needs_suffix: Set[str]) -> Dict[str, int]:
44	    """Return UUID prefix lengths that distinguish suffixed peers."""
45	    lengths = {container.uuid: min(8, len(container.uuid)) for container in containers if container.uuid in needs_suffix}
46	    while True:
47	        groups: Dict[Tuple[str, str], List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
48	        for container in containers:
49	            if container.uuid not in needs_suffix:
50	                continue
51	            key = (bases[container.uuid].casefold(), container.uuid[:lengths[container.uuid]].casefold())
52	            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(container)
53	        duplicates = [group for group in groups.values() if len(group) > 1]
54	        if not duplicates:
55	            return lengths
56	        changed = False
57	        for group in duplicates:
58	            for container in group:
59	                current = lengths[container.uuid]
60	                if current < len(container.uuid):
61	                    lengths[container.uuid] = current + 1
62	                    changed = True
63	        if not changed:
64	            # UUIDs are unique, so this is defensive only for non-standard inputs.
65	            return lengths

122	) -> Tuple[ContainerPath, ...]:

157	    if task.status == "canceled":

209	    tasks_by_file[Path("Upcoming.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.upcoming_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
210	
211	    files = {path: render_document(titles[path], tasks) for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items()}
212	    return RenderedSnapshot(files=files, containers=containers)

45	def _unique_suffix_lengths(containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], needs_suffix: Set[str]) -> Dict[str, int]:
46	    """Return UUID prefix lengths that distinguish suffixed peers."""
47	    lengths = {container.uuid: min(8, len(container.uuid)) for container in containers if container.uuid in needs_suffix}
48	    while True:
49	        groups: Dict[Tuple[str, str], List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
50	        for container in containers:
51	            if container.uuid not in needs_suffix:
52	                continue
53	            key = (bases[container.uuid].casefold(), container.uuid[:lengths[container.uuid]].casefold())
54	            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(container)
55	        duplicates = [group for group in groups.values() if len(group) > 1]
56	        if not duplicates:

58	        changed = False
59	        for group in duplicates:
60	            for container in group:

62	                if current < len(container.uuid):

64	                    changed = True

152	def allocate_container_paths(
153	    projects: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], areas: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot]
154	) -> Tuple[ContainerPath, ...]:
155	    """Allocate safe relative directories for active projects and areas."""
156	    paths = _allocate_kind(projects, "project", "Projects")
157	    paths.extend(_allocate_kind(areas, "area", "Areas"))
158	    return tuple(sorted(paths, key=lambda item: (item.kind, item.relative_dir.as_posix().casefold(), item.uuid)))

162	    return (task.index, task.created or "", task.title.casefold(), task.uuid)
163	
164	
165	def _descending_text(value: str) -> str:
166	    return "".join(chr(0x10FFFF - ord(character)) for character in value)
167	
168	
169	def _terminal_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, int, str, str, str]:
170	    return (_descending_text(task.stop_date or ""),) + _primary_sort_key(task)

173	def _document_title(path: Path, suffix: str) -> str:
174	    if len(path.parts) == 1:
175	        return suffix
176	    return " / ".join(path.parts[:-1]) + " / " + suffix
177

179	def _primary_file(
180	    task: TaskSnapshot,
181	    project_paths: Dict[str, Path],
182	    area_paths: Dict[str, Path],
183	) -> Path:
184	    base = project_paths.get(task.project_uuid or "")
185	    if base is None:
186	        base = area_paths.get(task.area_uuid or "")
187	    if task.status == "completed":
188	        return base / "已完成.md" if base else Path("已完成.md")
189	    if task.status == "canceled":
190	        return base / "已取消.md" if base else Path("已取消.md")
191	    if base:
192	        return base / "tasks.md"
193	    if task.start not in _VALID_STARTS:
194	        _LOG.warning("Incomplete task %s has invalid or missing start %r; routing to Anytime", task.uuid, task.start)
195	        return Path("Anytime.md")
196	    return Path(task.start + ".md")

199	def _dynamic_tasks(
200	    uuids: Sequence[str], tasks: Dict[str, TaskSnapshot], warned: Set[str]
201	) -> List[TaskSnapshot]:
202	    selected = []
203	    for uuid in uuids:
204	        task = tasks.get(uuid)
205	        if task is None:
206	            if uuid not in warned:
207	                _LOG.warning("Dynamic view references missing task UUID %s", uuid)
208	                warned.add(uuid)
209	            continue
210	        selected.append(task)
211	    return selected
212	
213	
214	def render_snapshot(snapshot: ThingsSnapshot) -> RenderedSnapshot:
215	    """Render an immutable, entirely in-memory representation of a snapshot."""
216	    containers = allocate_container_paths(snapshot.projects, snapshot.areas)
217	    project_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "project"}
218	    area_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "area"}
219	    active_tasks = tuple(task for task in snapshot.tasks if not task.trashed)
220	
221	    tasks_by_file: Dict[Path, List[TaskSnapshot]] = {path: [] for path, _ in _ROOT_FILES}
222	    titles: Dict[Path, str] = {path: title for path, title in _ROOT_FILES}
223	    for container in containers:
224	        for filename, suffix in _CONTAINER_FILES:
225	            path = container.relative_dir / filename
226	            tasks_by_file[path] = []
227	            titles[path] = _document_title(path, suffix)
228	
229	    for task in active_tasks:
230	        tasks_by_file[_primary_file(task, project_paths, area_paths)].append(task)
231	
232	    for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items():
233	        if path.name in {"已完成.md", "已取消.md"}:
234	            tasks.sort(key=_terminal_sort_key)
235	        else:
236	            tasks.sort(key=_primary_sort_key)
237	
238	    active_by_uuid = {task.uuid: task for task in active_tasks}
239	    warned_missing: Set[str] = set()
240	    tasks_by_file[Path("Today.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.today_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
241	    tasks_by_file[Path("Upcoming.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.upcoming_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
242	
243	    files = {path: render_document(titles[path], tasks) for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items()}
244	    return RenderedSnapshot(files=files, containers=containers)

46	def _suffix_segment(base: str, uuid: str, length: int, ordinal: int = 0) -> str:
47	    suffix = "-" + _uuid_token(uuid)[:length]
48	    if ordinal:
49	        suffix += "-" + str(ordinal)
50	    available = _MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH - len(suffix)
51	    if available <= 0:
52	        return suffix[-_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH:]
53	    return base[:available].rstrip(".").strip() + suffix
54	
55	
56	def _unique_suffix_lengths(containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], needs_suffix: Set[str]) -> Dict[str, int]:
57	    """Return UUID prefix lengths that distinguish suffixed peers."""
58	    lengths = {
59	        container.uuid: min(8, len(_uuid_token(container.uuid)))
60	        for container in containers
61	        if container.uuid in needs_suffix
62	    }
63	    while True:
64	        groups: Dict[Tuple[str, str], List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
65	        for container in containers:
66	            if container.uuid not in needs_suffix:
67	                continue
68	            token = _uuid_token(container.uuid)
69	            key = (bases[container.uuid].casefold(), token[:lengths[container.uuid]].casefold())
70	            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(container)
71	        duplicates = [group for group in groups.values() if len(group) > 1]
72	        if not duplicates:
73	            return lengths
74	        changed = False
75	        for group in duplicates:
76	            for container in group:
77	                current = lengths[container.uuid]
78	                token = _uuid_token(container.uuid)
79	                if current < len(token):
80	                    lengths[container.uuid] = current + 1
81	                    changed = True
82	        if not changed:
83	            # UUIDs are unique, so this is defensive only for non-standard inputs.
84	            return lengths
85	
86	
87	def _collision_ordinals(
88	    containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], lengths: Dict[str, int], needs_suffix: Set[str]
89	) -> Dict[str, int]:
90	    """Assign stable ordinal suffixes to residual case-insensitive collisions."""
91	    candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
92	    for container in containers:
93	        segment = (
94	            _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
95	            if container.uuid in needs_suffix
96	            else bases[container.uuid]
97	        )
98	        candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
99	
100	    ordinals: Dict[str, int] = {}
101	    for group in candidates.values():
102	        if len(group) > 1:
103	            for ordinal, container in enumerate(sorted(group, key=_container_sort_key), start=1):
104	                ordinals[container.uuid] = ordinal
105	    return ordinals
106	
107	
108	def _allocate_kind(containers: Iterable[ContainerSnapshot], kind: str, root: str) -> List[ContainerPath]:
109	    active = sorted(
110	        (container for container in containers if not container.trashed),
111	        key=_container_sort_key,
112	    )
113	    bases = {
114	        container.uuid: sanitize_path_segment(
115	            container.title, "{}-{}".format(kind, _uuid_token(container.uuid)[:8])
116	        )
117	        for container in active
118	    }
119	    needs_suffix: Set[str] = set()
120	
121	    # A case-insensitive duplicate cannot retain either clean segment.
122	    by_clean_name: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
123	    for container in active:
124	        by_clean_name.setdefault(bases[container.uuid].casefold(), []).append(container)
125	    for group in by_clean_name.values():
126	        if len(group) > 1:
127	            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
128	
129	    # A generated suffix can naturally be another container title.  Mark every
130	    # conflicting path for suffixing, then repeat until all candidates are unique.
131	    while True:
132	        lengths = _unique_suffix_lengths(active, bases, needs_suffix)
133	        candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
134	        for container in active:
135	            segment = (
136	                _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
137	                if container.uuid in needs_suffix
138	                else bases[container.uuid]
139	            )
140	            candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
141	        conflicts = [group for group in candidates.values() if len(group) > 1]
142	        if not conflicts:
143	            break
144	        previous_count = len(needs_suffix)
145	        for group in conflicts:
146	            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
147	        if len(needs_suffix) == previous_count:
148	            break
149	
150	    ordinals = _collision_ordinals(active, bases, lengths, needs_suffix)
151	    paths = []
152	    used_segments: Set[str] = set()
153	    for container in active:
154	        if container.uuid in needs_suffix:
155	            ordinal = ordinals.get(container.uuid, 0)
156	            segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
157	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
158	                ordinal += 1
159	                segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
160	        else:
161	            segment = bases[container.uuid]
162	            ordinal = 0
163	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
164	                ordinal += 1
165	                segment = _suffix_segment(
166	                    bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, len(_uuid_token(container.uuid)), ordinal
167	                )
168	        used_segments.add(segment.casefold())
169	        paths.append(ContainerPath(container.uuid, kind, Path(root) / segment))
170	    return paths
171	
172	
173	def allocate_container_paths(
174	    projects: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], areas: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot]
175	) -> Tuple[ContainerPath, ...]:
176	    """Allocate safe relative directories for active projects and areas."""
177	    paths = _allocate_kind(projects, "project", "Projects")
178	    paths.extend(_allocate_kind(areas, "area", "Areas"))
179	    return tuple(sorted(paths, key=lambda item: (item.kind, item.relative_dir.as_posix().casefold(), item.uuid)))
180	
181	
182	def _primary_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[int, str, str, str]:
183	    return (task.index, task.created or "", task.title.casefold(), task.uuid)
184	
185	
186	def _descending_text(value: str) -> str:
187	    return "".join(chr(0x10FFFF - ord(character)) for character in value)
188	
189	
190	def _terminal_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, int, str, str, str]:
191	    return (_descending_text(task.stop_date or ""),) + _primary_sort_key(task)
192	
193	
194	def _document_title(path: Path, suffix: str) -> str:
195	    if len(path.parts) == 1:
196	        return suffix
197	    return " / ".join(path.parts[:-1]) + " / " + suffix
198	
199	
200	def _primary_file(
201	    task: TaskSnapshot,
202	    project_paths: Dict[str, Path],
203	    area_paths: Dict[str, Path],
204	) -> Path:
205	    base = project_paths.get(task.project_uuid or "")
206	    if base is None:
207	        base = area_paths.get(task.area_uuid or "")
208	    if task.status == "completed":
209	        return base / "已完成.md" if base else Path("已完成.md")
210	    if task.status == "canceled":
211	        return base / "已取消.md" if base else Path("已取消.md")
212	    if base:
213	        return base / "tasks.md"
214	    if task.start not in _VALID_STARTS:
215	        _LOG.warning("Incomplete task %s has invalid or missing start %r; routing to Anytime", task.uuid, task.start)
216	        return Path("Anytime.md")
217	    return Path(task.start + ".md")
218	
219	
220	def _dynamic_tasks(
221	    uuids: Sequence[str], tasks: Dict[str, TaskSnapshot], warned: Set[str]
222	) -> List[TaskSnapshot]:
223	    selected = []
224	    for uuid in uuids:
225	        task = tasks.get(uuid)
226	        if task is None:
227	            if uuid not in warned:
228	                _LOG.warning("Dynamic view references missing task UUID %s", uuid)
229	                warned.add(uuid)
230	            continue
231	        selected.append(task)
232	    return selected
233	
234	
235	def render_snapshot(snapshot: ThingsSnapshot) -> RenderedSnapshot:
236	    """Render an immutable, entirely in-memory representation of a snapshot."""
237	    containers = allocate_container_paths(snapshot.projects, snapshot.areas)
238	    project_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "project"}
239	    area_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "area"}
240	    active_tasks = tuple(task for task in snapshot.tasks if not task.trashed)
241	
242	    tasks_by_file: Dict[Path, List[TaskSnapshot]] = {path: [] for path, _ in _ROOT_FILES}
243	    titles: Dict[Path, str] = {path: title for path, title in _ROOT_FILES}
244	    for container in containers:
245	        for filename, suffix in _CONTAINER_FILES:
246	            path = container.relative_dir / filename
247	            tasks_by_file[path] = []
248	            titles[path] = _document_title(path, suffix)
249	
250	    for task in active_tasks:
251	        tasks_by_file[_primary_file(task, project_paths, area_paths)].append(task)
252	
253	    for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items():
254	        if path.name in {"已完成.md", "已取消.md"}:
255	            tasks.sort(key=_terminal_sort_key)
256	        else:
257	            tasks.sort(key=_primary_sort_key)
258	
259	    active_by_uuid = {task.uuid: task for task in active_tasks}
260	    warned_missing: Set[str] = set()
261	    tasks_by_file[Path("Today.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.today_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
262	    tasks_by_file[Path("Upcoming.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.upcoming_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
263	
264	    files = {path: render_document(titles[path], tasks) for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items()}
265	    return RenderedSnapshot(files=files, containers=containers)
266	
```

8	def parse_bool(name: str, raw: str) -> bool:
9	    value = raw.strip().lower()
10	    if value in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}: return True
11	    if value in {"0", "false", "no", "off"}: return False

15	    value = _INVALID_PATH_CHARS.sub("-", title).strip().rstrip(".").strip()
16	    value = value or fallback
17	    return value[:max_length].rstrip(".").strip() or fallback[:max_length]

19	def setup_logging(log_dir: Path, level: str, max_bytes: int, backup_count: int) -> None:
20	    log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
21	    formatter = logging.Formatter("%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
22	    file_handler = RotatingFileHandler(log_dir / "sync.log", maxBytes=max_bytes, backupCount=backup_count, encoding="utf-8")
23	    stream_handler = logging.StreamHandler()
24	    file_handler.setFormatter(formatter); stream_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
25	    logging.basicConfig(level=getattr(logging, level.upper()), handlers=[file_handler, stream_handler], force=True)

1	"""Deterministic Markdown rendering for Things task snapshots."""
2	
3	import re
4	from typing import Sequence
5	
6	from .models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
7	
8	GENERATED_MARKER = "<!-- generated-by: things3-github-sync; do not edit -->"
9	
10	_STATUS_MARKERS = {
11	    "incomplete": " ",
12	    "completed": "x",
13	    "canceled": "-",
14	}
15	_INLINE_SPECIALS = "\\`*_[]<>"
16	
17	
18	def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
19	    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
20	    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
21	    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
22	    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
23	    escaped = []
24	    for character in normalized:
25	        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
26	            escaped.append("\\")
27	        escaped.append(character)
28	    return "".join(escaped)
29	
30	
31	def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
32	    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
33	
34	
35	def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
36	    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
37	
38	
39	def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
40	    rendered = []
41	    for tag in tags:
42	        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
43	        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
44	        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
45	    return " ".join(rendered)
46	
47	
48	def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
49	    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
50	    lines = normalized.split("\n")
51	    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
52	        lines.pop()
53	    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
54	        return ()
55	    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
56	
57	
58	def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
59	    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
60	    if item.stop_date:
61	        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
62	    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
63	
64	
65	def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
66	    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
67	    lines = [
68	        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
69	        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
70	    ]
71	
72	    fields = (
73	        ("创建时间", task.created),
74	        ("修改时间", task.modified),
75	        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
76	        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
77	        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
78	        ("项目", task.project_title),
79	        ("领域", task.area_title),
80	        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
81	    )
82	    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
83	
84	    if task.tags:
85	        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
86	
87	    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
88	    if note_lines:
89	        lines.append("- **备注**:")
90	        lines.extend(note_lines)
91	
92	    if task.checklist:
93	        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
94	        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
95	
96	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
97	
98	
99	def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
100	    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
101	    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
102	    if not tasks:
103	        return header
104	
105	    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
106	    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"
107	
108	
109	def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
110	    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
111	    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
112	    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER
113

139	    """Replace a UTF-8 text file atomically with a sibling temporary file."""
140	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
141	    temporary_path = None
142	    try:
143	        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
144	            mode="w",
145	            encoding="utf-8",
146	            newline="\n",
147	            dir=path.parent,
148	            prefix=".{}.".format(path.name),
149	            suffix=".tmp",
150	            delete=False,
151	        ) as temporary_file:
152	            temporary_path = Path(temporary_file.name)
153	            temporary_file.write(content)
154	            temporary_file.flush()
155	            os.fsync(temporary_file.fileno())
156	        os.replace(temporary_path, path)
157	    finally:
158	        if temporary_path is not None:
159	            try:
160	                temporary_path.unlink()
161	            except FileNotFoundError:
162	                pass
163	
164	
165	def _read_text(path: Path) -> str:
166	    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
167	
168	
169	def _remove_empty_container_directories(repo_path: Path, containers: Mapping[str, Path]) -> None:
170	    root = repo_path.resolve()
171	    stop_names = {"Projects", "Areas"}
172	    for relative_dir in set(containers.values()):
173	        current = repo_path / relative_dir
174	        while current != repo_path and current.name not in stop_names:
175	            try:
176	                current.rmdir()
177	            except OSError:
178	                break
179	            current = current.parent
180	        if current.resolve() == root:
181	            continue
182	
183	
184	def _container_mapping(repo_path: Path, rendered: RenderedSnapshot) -> Mapping[str, Path]:
185	    containers = {}
186	    for container in rendered.containers:
187	        relative_dir = container.relative_dir
188	        _require_safe_path(repo_path, relative_dir)
189	        key = "{}:{}".format(container.kind, container.uuid)
190	        if key in containers and containers[key] != relative_dir:
191	            raise ValueError("duplicate container identity: {}".format(key))
192	        containers[key] = relative_dir
193	    return containers
194	
195	
196	def _preflight_destination(repo_path: Path, relative_path: Path, previous: Manifest) -> None:
197	    """Ensure every existing destination component is safe before writes begin."""
198	    destination = repo_path / relative_path
199	    current = repo_path
200	    for component in relative_path.parts:
201	        current = current / component
202	        if not os.path.lexists(str(current)):
203	            continue
204	        if current.is_symlink():
205	            raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path))
206	        if current == destination:
207	            if not current.is_file():
208	                raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path))
209	            if relative_path in previous.managed_files:
210	                return
211	            try:
212	                managed = is_managed_markdown(_read_text(current))
213	            except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as error:
214	                raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path)) from error
215	            if not managed:
216	                raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path))
217	            return
218	        if not current.is_dir():
219	            raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path))
220	
221	
222	def reconcile(repo_path: Path, rendered: RenderedSnapshot) -> ChangeSet:
223	    """Reconcile managed files, preserving unowned paths and writing manifest last."""
224	    repo_path = Path(repo_path)
225	    desired = dict(rendered.files)
226	    for relative_path, content in desired.items():
227	        if not isinstance(relative_path, Path) or not isinstance(content, str):
228	            raise ValueError("rendered files must map paths to text")
229	        _require_safe_path(repo_path, relative_path)
230	    active_containers = _container_mapping(repo_path, rendered)
231	    previous = load_manifest(repo_path)
232	
233	    # Complete ownership preflight must finish before the first filesystem mutation.
234	    for relative_path in sorted(desired):
235	        _preflight_destination(repo_path, relative_path, previous)
236	
237	    desired_paths = tuple(sorted(desired))
238	    new_manifest = Manifest(
239	        managed_files=desired_paths,
240	        active_containers=active_containers,
241	        archived_containers=previous.archived_containers,
242	    )
243	    added = []
244	    modified = []
245	    deleted = []
246	    for relative_path in desired_paths:
247	        destination = repo_path / relative_path
248	        if not destination.exists():
249	            _atomic_write(destination, desired[relative_path])
250	            added.append(relative_path)
251	        elif _read_text(destination) != desired[relative_path]:
252	            _atomic_write(destination, desired[relative_path])
253	            modified.append(relative_path)
254	
255	    for relative_path in previous.managed_files:
256	        if relative_path in desired:
257	            continue
258	        stale_path = repo_path / relative_path
259	        if not stale_path.exists():
260	            continue
261	        if stale_path.is_file() and is_managed_markdown(_read_text(stale_path)):
262	            stale_path.unlink()
263	            deleted.append(relative_path)
264	        else:
265	            _LOG.warning("Not deleting unmarked file: %s", relative_path)
266	    _remove_empty_container_directories(repo_path, previous.active_containers)
267	
268	    manifest_path = repo_path / MANIFEST_PATH
269	    manifest_content = _manifest_content(new_manifest)
270	    if not manifest_path.exists():
271	        _atomic_write(manifest_path, manifest_content)
272	        added.append(MANIFEST_PATH)
273	    elif _read_text(manifest_path) != manifest_content:
274	        _atomic_write(manifest_path, manifest_content)
275	        modified.append(MANIFEST_PATH)
276	
277	    git_paths = set(previous.managed_files) | set(new_manifest.managed_files)
278	    git_paths.add(MANIFEST_PATH)
279	    git_paths.update(added)
280	    git_paths.update(modified)
281	    git_paths.update(deleted)
282	    return ChangeSet(added=tuple(added), modified=tuple(modified), deleted=tuple(deleted), git_paths=tuple(git_paths))
283	
```

18	def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
19	    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
20	    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
21	    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
22	    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
23	    escaped = []
24	    for character in normalized:
25	        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
26	            escaped.append("\\")
27	        escaped.append(character)
28	    return "".join(escaped)
29	
30	
31	def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
32	    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
33	
34	
35	def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
36	    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
37	
38	
39	def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
40	    rendered = []
41	    for tag in tags:
42	        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
43	        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
44	        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
45	    return " ".join(rendered)
46	
47	
48	def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
49	    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
50	    lines = normalized.split("\n")
51	    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
52	        lines.pop()
53	    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
54	        return ()
55	    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
56	
57	
58	def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
59	    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
60	    if item.stop_date:
61	        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
62	    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
63	
64	
65	def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
66	    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
67	    lines = [
68	        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
69	        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
70	    ]
71	
72	    fields = (
73	        ("创建时间", task.created),
74	        ("修改时间", task.modified),
75	        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
76	        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
77	        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
78	        ("项目", task.project_title),
79	        ("领域", task.area_title),
80	        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
81	    )
82	    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
83	
84	    if task.tags:
85	        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
86	
87	    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
88	    if note_lines:
89	        lines.append("- **备注**:")
90	        lines.extend(note_lines)
91	
92	    if task.checklist:
93	        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
94	        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
95	
96	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
97	
98	
99	def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
100	    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
101	    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
102	    if not tasks:
103	        return header
104	
105	    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
106	    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"
107	
108	
109	def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
110	    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
111	    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
112	    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER
113	
```

134	    elif task.area_uuid in area_paths:
135	        base = area_paths[task.area_uuid]
136	    else:
137	        base = None
138	
139	    if task.status == "completed":
140	        return (base / "已完成.md") if base else Path("已完成.md")
141	    if task.status == "canceled":
142	        return (base / "已取消.md") if base else Path("已取消.md")
143	    if base:
144	        return base / "tasks.md"
145	    return Path(f"{task.start if task.start in {'Inbox', 'Anytime', 'Someday'} else 'Anytime'}.md")

1	"""Deterministic Markdown rendering for Things task snapshots."""
2	
3	import re
4	from typing import Sequence
5	
6	from .models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
7	
8	GENERATED_MARKER = "<!-- generated-by: things3-github-sync; do not edit -->"
9	
10	_STATUS_MARKERS = {
11	    "incomplete": " ",
12	    "completed": "x",
13	    "canceled": "-",
14	}
15	_INLINE_SPECIALS = "\\`*_[]<>"
16	
17	
18	def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
19	    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
20	    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
21	    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
22	    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
23	    escaped = []
24	    for character in normalized:
25	        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
26	            escaped.append("\\")
27	        escaped.append(character)
28	    return "".join(escaped)
29	
30	
31	def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
32	    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
33	
34	
35	def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
36	    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
37	
38	
39	def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
40	    rendered = []
41	    for tag in tags:
42	        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
43	        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
44	        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
45	    return " ".join(rendered)
46	
47	
48	def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
49	    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
50	    lines = normalized.split("\n")
51	    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
52	        lines.pop()
53	    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
54	        return ()
55	    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
56	
57	
58	def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
59	    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
60	    if item.stop_date:
61	        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
62	    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
63	
64	
65	def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
66	    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
67	    lines = [
68	        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
69	        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
70	    ]
71	
72	    fields = (
73	        ("创建时间", task.created),
74	        ("修改时间", task.modified),
75	        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
76	        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
77	        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
78	        ("项目", task.project_title),
79	        ("领域", task.area_title),
80	        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
81	    )
82	    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
83	
84	    if task.tags:
85	        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
86	
87	    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
88	    if note_lines:
89	        lines.append("- **备注**:")
90	        lines.extend(note_lines)
91	
92	    if task.checklist:
93	        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
94	        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
95	
96	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
97	
98	
99	def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
100	    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
101	    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
102	    if not tasks:
103	        return header
104	
105	    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
106	    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"
107	
108	
109	def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
110	    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
111	    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
112	    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER

96	            else bases[container.uuid]
97	        )
98	        candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
99	
100	    ordinals: Dict[str, int] = {}
101	    for group in candidates.values():
102	        if len(group) > 1:
103	            for ordinal, container in enumerate(sorted(group, key=_container_sort_key), start=1):
104	                ordinals[container.uuid] = ordinal
105	    return ordinals
106	
107	
108	def _allocate_kind(containers: Iterable[ContainerSnapshot], kind: str, root: str) -> List[ContainerPath]:
109	    active = sorted(
110	        (container for container in containers if not container.trashed),
111	        key=_container_sort_key,
112	    )
113	    bases = {
114	        container.uuid: sanitize_path_segment(
115	            container.title, "{}-{}".format(kind, _uuid_token(container.uuid)[:8])
116	        )
117	        for container in active
118	    }
119	    needs_suffix: Set[str] = set()
120	
121	    # A case-insensitive duplicate cannot retain either clean segment.
122	    by_clean_name: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
123	    for container in active:
124	        by_clean_name.setdefault(bases[container.uuid].casefold(), []).append(container)
125	    for group in by_clean_name.values():
126	        if len(group) > 1:
127	            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
128	
129	    # A generated suffix can naturally be another container title.  Mark every
130	    # conflicting path for suffixing, then repeat until all candidates are unique.
131	    while True:
132	        lengths = _unique_suffix_lengths(active, bases, needs_suffix)
133	        candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
134	        for container in active:
135	            segment = (
136	                _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
137	                if container.uuid in needs_suffix
138	                else bases[container.uuid]
139	            )
140	            candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
141	        conflicts = [group for group in candidates.values() if len(group) > 1]
142	        if not conflicts:
143	            break
144	        previous_count = len(needs_suffix)
145	        for group in conflicts:
146	            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
147	        if len(needs_suffix) == previous_count:
148	            break
149	
150	    ordinals = _collision_ordinals(active, bases, lengths, needs_suffix)
151	    paths = []
152	    used_segments: Set[str] = set()
153	    for container in active:
154	        if container.uuid in needs_suffix:
155	            ordinal = ordinals.get(container.uuid, 0)
156	            segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
157	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
158	                ordinal += 1
159	                segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
160	        else:
161	            segment = bases[container.uuid]
162	            ordinal = 0
163	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
164	                ordinal += 1
165	                segment = _suffix_segment(
166	                    bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, len(_uuid_token(container.uuid)), ordinal
167	                )
168	        used_segments.add(segment.casefold())
169	        paths.append(ContainerPath(container.uuid, kind, Path(root) / segment))
170	    return paths
171	
172	
173	def allocate_container_paths(
174	    projects: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], areas: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot]
175	) -> Tuple[ContainerPath, ...]:
176	    """Allocate safe relative directories for active projects and areas."""
177	    paths = _allocate_kind(projects, "project", "Projects")
178	    paths.extend(_allocate_kind(areas, "area", "Areas"))
179	    return tuple(sorted(paths, key=lambda item: (item.kind, item.relative_dir.as_posix().casefold(), item.uuid)))
180	
181	
182	def _primary_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[int, str, str, str]:
183	    return (task.index, task.created or "", task.title.casefold(), task.uuid)
184	
185	
186	def _descending_text(value: str) -> str:
187	    return "".join(chr(0x10FFFF - ord(character)) for character in value)
188	
189	
190	def _terminal_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, int, str, str, str]:
191	    return (_descending_text(task.stop_date or ""),) + _primary_sort_key(task)
192	
193	
194	def _document_title(path: Path, suffix: str) -> str:
195	    if len(path.parts) == 1:
196	        return suffix
197	    return " / ".join(path.parts[:-1]) + " / " + suffix
198	
199	
200	def _primary_file(
201	    task: TaskSnapshot,
202	    project_paths: Dict[str, Path],
203	    area_paths: Dict[str, Path],
204	) -> Path:
205	    base = project_paths.get(task.project_uuid or "")
206	    if base is None:
207	        base = area_paths.get(task.area_uuid or "")
208	    if task.status == "completed":
209	        return base / "已完成.md" if base else Path("已完成.md")
210	    if task.status == "canceled":
211	        return base / "已取消.md" if base else Path("已取消.md")
212	    if base:
213	        return base / "tasks.md"
214	    if task.start not in _VALID_STARTS:
215	        _LOG.warning("Incomplete task %s has invalid or missing start %r; routing to Anytime", task.uuid, task.start)
216	        return Path("Anytime.md")
217	    return Path(task.start + ".md")
218	
219	
220	def _dynamic_tasks(
221	    uuids: Sequence[str], tasks: Dict[str, TaskSnapshot], warned: Set[str]
222	) -> List[TaskSnapshot]:
223	    selected = []
224	    for uuid in uuids:
225	        task = tasks.get(uuid)
226	        if task is None:
227	            if uuid not in warned:
228	                _LOG.warning("Dynamic view references missing task UUID %s", uuid)
229	                warned.add(uuid)
230	            continue
231	        selected.append(task)
232	    return selected
233	
234	
235	def render_snapshot(snapshot: ThingsSnapshot) -> RenderedSnapshot:
236	    """Render an immutable, entirely in-memory representation of a snapshot."""
237	    containers = allocate_container_paths(snapshot.projects, snapshot.areas)
238	    project_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "project"}
239	    area_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "area"}
240	    active_tasks = tuple(task for task in snapshot.tasks if not task.trashed)
241	
242	    tasks_by_file: Dict[Path, List[TaskSnapshot]] = {path: [] for path, _ in _ROOT_FILES}
243	    titles: Dict[Path, str] = {path: title for path, title in _ROOT_FILES}
244	    for container in containers:
245	        for filename, suffix in _CONTAINER_FILES:
246	            path = container.relative_dir / filename
247	            tasks_by_file[path] = []
248	            titles[path] = _document_title(path, suffix)
249	
250	    for task in active_tasks:
251	        tasks_by_file[_primary_file(task, project_paths, area_paths)].append(task)
252	
253	    for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items():
254	        if path.name in {"已完成.md", "已取消.md"}:
255	            tasks.sort(key=_terminal_sort_key)
256	        else:
257	            tasks.sort(key=_primary_sort_key)
258	
259	    active_by_uuid = {task.uuid: task for task in active_tasks}
260	    warned_missing: Set[str] = set()
261	    tasks_by_file[Path("Today.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.today_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
262	    tasks_by_file[Path("Upcoming.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.upcoming_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
263	
264	    files = {path: render_document(titles[path], tasks) for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items()}
265	    return RenderedSnapshot(files=files, containers=containers)
266	
```

139	def _atomic_write(path: Path, content: str) -> None:
140	    """Replace a UTF-8 text file atomically with a sibling temporary file."""
141	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
142	    temporary_path = None
143	    try:
144	        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
145	            mode="w",
146	            encoding="utf-8",

148	            dir=path.parent,
149	            prefix=".{}.".format(path.name),
150	            suffix=".tmp",
151	            delete=False,
152	        ) as temporary_file:
153	            temporary_path = Path(temporary_file.name)
154	            temporary_file.write(content)
155	            temporary_file.flush()
156	            os.fsync(temporary_file.fileno())
157	        os.replace(temporary_path, path)
158	    finally:
159	        if temporary_path is not None:
160	            try:

162	            except FileNotFoundError:

139	def _atomic_write(path: Path, content: str) -> None:
140	    """Replace a UTF-8 text file atomically with a sibling temporary file."""
141	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
142	    temporary_path = None
143	    try:
144	        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
145	            mode="w",
146	            encoding="utf-8",
147	            newline="\n",
148	            dir=path.parent,
149	            prefix=".{}.".format(path.name),
150	            suffix=".tmp",
151	            delete=False,
152	        ) as temporary_file:
153	            temporary_path = Path(temporary_file.name)
154	            temporary_file.write(content)
155	            temporary_file.flush()
156	            os.fsync(temporary_file.fileno())
157	        os.replace(temporary_path, path)
158	    finally:
159	        if temporary_path is not None:
160	            try:
161	                temporary_path.unlink()

35	def _uuid_token(uuid: str) -> str:
36	    """Return a deterministic, one-segment-safe representation of a UUID."""
37	    token = []
38	    for character in uuid:
39	        if character.isascii() and (character.isalnum() or character in "-_"):
40	            token.append(character)
41	        else:

43	    return "".join(token) or "uuid"

46	def _suffix_segment(base: str, uuid: str, length: int, ordinal: int = 0) -> str:
47	    suffix = "-" + _uuid_token(uuid)[:length]
48	    if ordinal:
49	        suffix += "-" + str(ordinal)
50	    available = _MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH - len(suffix)
51	    if available <= 0:
52	        return suffix[-_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH:]
53	    return base[:available].rstrip(".").strip() + suffix

56	def _unique_suffix_lengths(containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], needs_suffix: Set[str]) -> Dict[str, int]:
57	    """Return UUID prefix lengths that distinguish suffixed peers."""
58	    lengths = {
59	        container.uuid: min(8, len(_uuid_token(container.uuid)))
60	        for container in containers
61	        if container.uuid in needs_suffix
62	    }
63	    while True:
64	        groups: Dict[Tuple[str, str], List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
65	        for container in containers:
66	            if container.uuid not in needs_suffix:
67	                continue
68	            token = _uuid_token(container.uuid)
69	            key = (bases[container.uuid].casefold(), token[:lengths[container.uuid]].casefold())
70	            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(container)
71	        duplicates = [group for group in groups.values() if len(group) > 1]
72	        if not duplicates:
73	            return lengths
74	        changed = False
75	        for group in duplicates:
76	            for container in group:
77	                current = lengths[container.uuid]
78	                token = _uuid_token(container.uuid)
79	                if current < len(token):
80	                    lengths[container.uuid] = current + 1
81	                    changed = True
82	        if not changed:
83	            # UUIDs are unique, so this is defensive only for non-standard inputs.
84	            return lengths
85

195	    if len(path.parts) == 1:

197	    return " / ".join(path.parts[:-1]) + " / " + suffix

200	def _primary_file(
201	    task: TaskSnapshot,
202	    project_paths: Dict[str, Path],
203	    area_paths: Dict[str, Path],
204	) -> Path:
205	    base = project_paths.get(task.project_uuid or "")
206	    if base is None:
207	        base = area_paths.get(task.area_uuid or "")
208	    if task.status == "completed":
209	        return base / "已完成.md" if base else Path("已完成.md")
210	    if task.status == "canceled":
211	        return base / "已取消.md" if base else Path("已取消.md")
212	    if base:
213	        return base / "tasks.md"
214	    if task.start not in _VALID_STARTS:
215	        _LOG.warning("Incomplete task %s has invalid or missing start %r; routing to Anytime", task.uuid, task.start)
216	        return Path("Anytime.md")
217	    return Path(task.start + ".md")

220	def _dynamic_tasks(
221	    uuids: Sequence[str], tasks: Dict[str, TaskSnapshot], warned: Set[str]
222	) -> List[TaskSnapshot]:
223	    selected = []

227	            if uuid not in warned:
228	                _LOG.warning("Dynamic view references missing task UUID %s", uuid)
229	                warned.add(uuid)
230	            continue
231	        selected.append(task)
232	    return selected

235	def render_snapshot(snapshot: ThingsSnapshot) -> RenderedSnapshot:
236	    """Render an immutable, entirely in-memory representation of a snapshot."""
237	    containers = allocate_container_paths(snapshot.projects, snapshot.areas)
238	    project_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "project"}
239	    area_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "area"}
240	    active_tasks = tuple(task for task in snapshot.tasks if not task.trashed)
241	
242	    tasks_by_file: Dict[Path, List[TaskSnapshot]] = {path: [] for path, _ in _ROOT_FILES}
243	    titles: Dict[Path, str] = {path: title for path, title in _ROOT_FILES}
244	    for container in containers:
245	        for filename, suffix in _CONTAINER_FILES:
246	            path = container.relative_dir / filename
247	            tasks_by_file[path] = []
248	            titles[path] = _document_title(path, suffix)
249	
250	    for task in active_tasks:
251	        tasks_by_file[_primary_file(task, project_paths, area_paths)].append(task)
252	
253	    for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items():
254	        if path.name in {"已完成.md", "已取消.md"}:
255	            tasks.sort(key=_terminal_sort_key)
256	        else:
257	            tasks.sort(key=_primary_sort_key)
258

260	    warned_missing: Set[str] = set()

262	    tasks_by_file[Path("Upcoming.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.upcoming_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
263	
264	    files = {path: render_document(titles[path], tasks) for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items()}

1	# Task 4 Independent Review
2	
3	## Verdicts
4	
5	1. **Specification compliance: FAIL**
6	2. **Code quality: FAIL**
7	
8	The implementation satisfies the remaining reviewed requirements: it is pure and in-memory; excludes trashed tasks and containers; emits seven root documents and three documents per active container; routes project before area and terminal states before start lists; preserves dynamic UUID order while omitting and warning once for missing UUIDs; applies deterministic primary and terminal ordering; and uses relative `Path` keys. The supplied report records 30 passing tests and a clean `git diff --check`; those commands were not re-run.
9	
10	## Findings
11	
12	### Important — collision resolution can emit duplicate container paths
13	
14	- **Location:** `src/renderer.py:105-115`
15	- **Failure scenario:** Two active containers have different UUIDs differing only by case (for example `AAAAAAAA` and `aaaaaaaa`) and titles that collide case-insensitively (for example `Release` and `release`). `_unique_suffix_lengths()` compares UUID prefixes with `.casefold()`. Once both prefixes have reached the full UUID length, it returns identical case-folded suffixes. The outer loop detects the collision, but since both members already have suffixes, `needs_suffix` does not grow and line 107 breaks. Both containers are then returned with the same case-insensitive path, so their generated documents overwrite one another in the `files` mapping.
16	- **Narrow remedy:** Make the disambiguator unique under the target filesystem comparison rule even for UUIDs that are equal case-insensitively. For example, retain an explicitly deterministic ordinal derived from the sorted collision group when full case-folded UUID prefixes still collide, and include it in the segment while preserving the 120-character limit. Continue collision resolution until every candidate `casefold()` path is unique rather than breaking with a collision.
17	
18	### Minor — test coverage omits the unresolvable-prefix collision boundary
19	
20	- **Location:** `tests/test_renderer.py:92-102`
21	- **Failure scenario:** The existing collision test exercises UUIDs sharing an eight-character prefix but eventually differing case-sensitively. It does not cover UUIDs that are distinct Python strings yet case-insensitively identical, which exposes the duplicate-path behavior above. Regression tests stay green while one container’s three documents disappear from `RenderedSnapshot.files`.
22	- **Narrow remedy:** Add a focused path-allocation test using `AAAAAAAA` and `aaaaaaaa` with case-colliding titles; assert unique `relative_dir.as_posix().casefold()` values and that rendering produces three documents for each container.
23

1	# Task 4 Independent Review
2	
3	## Verdicts
4	
5	1. **Specification compliance: FAIL**
6	2. **Code quality: FAIL**
7	
8	The implementation satisfies the remaining reviewed requirements: it is pure and in-memory; excludes trashed tasks and containers; emits seven root documents and three documents per active container; routes project before area and terminal states before start lists; preserves dynamic UUID order while omitting and warning once for missing UUIDs; applies deterministic primary and terminal ordering; and uses relative `Path` keys. The supplied report records 30 passing tests and a clean `git diff --check`; those commands were not re-run.
9	
10	## Findings
11	
12	### Important — collision resolution can emit duplicate container paths
13	
14	- **Location:** `src/renderer.py:105-115`
15	- **Failure scenario:** Two active containers have different UUIDs differing only by case (for example `AAAAAAAA` and `aaaaaaaa`) and titles that collide case-insensitively (for example `Release` and `release`). `_unique_suffix_lengths()` compares UUID prefixes with `.casefold()`. Once both prefixes have reached the full UUID length, it returns identical case-folded suffixes. The outer loop detects the collision, but since both members already have suffixes, `needs_suffix` does not grow and line 107 breaks. Both containers are then returned with the same case-insensitive path, so their generated documents overwrite one another in the `files` mapping.
16	- **Narrow remedy:** Make the disambiguator unique under the target filesystem comparison rule even for UUIDs that are equal case-insensitively. For example, retain an explicitly deterministic ordinal derived from the sorted collision group when full case-folded UUID prefixes still collide, and include it in the segment while preserving the 120-character limit. Continue collision resolution until every candidate `casefold()` path is unique rather than breaking with a collision.
17	
18	### Minor — test coverage omits the unresolvable-prefix collision boundary
19	
20	- **Location:** `tests/test_renderer.py:92-102`
21	- **Failure scenario:** The existing collision test exercises UUIDs sharing an eight-character prefix but eventually differing case-sensitively. It does not cover UUIDs that are distinct Python strings yet case-insensitively identical, which exposes the duplicate-path behavior above. Regression tests stay green while one container’s three documents disappear from `RenderedSnapshot.files`.
22	- **Narrow remedy:** Add a focused path-allocation test using `AAAAAAAA` and `aaaaaaaa` with case-colliding titles; assert unique `relative_dir.as_posix().casefold()` values and that rendering produces three documents for each container.
23

195	        return Path("Anytime.md")
196	    return Path(task.start + ".md")
197	
198	
199	def _dynamic_tasks(
200	    uuids: Sequence[str], tasks: Dict[str, TaskSnapshot], warned: Set[str]
201	) -> List[TaskSnapshot]:
202	    selected = []
203	    for uuid in uuids:
204	        task = tasks.get(uuid)
205	        if task is None:
206	            if uuid not in warned:
207	                _LOG.warning("Dynamic view references missing task UUID %s", uuid)
208	                warned.add(uuid)
209	            continue
210	        selected.append(task)
211	    return selected
212	
213	
214	def render_snapshot(snapshot: ThingsSnapshot) -> RenderedSnapshot:
215	    """Render an immutable, entirely in-memory representation of a snapshot."""
216	    containers = allocate_container_paths(snapshot.projects, snapshot.areas)
217	    project_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "project"}
218	    area_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "area"}
219	    active_tasks = tuple(task for task in snapshot.tasks if not task.trashed)
220	
221	    tasks_by_file: Dict[Path, List[TaskSnapshot]] = {path: [] for path, _ in _ROOT_FILES}
222	    titles: Dict[Path, str] = {path: title for path, title in _ROOT_FILES}
223	    for container in containers:
224	        for filename, suffix in _CONTAINER_FILES:
225	            path = container.relative_dir / filename
226	            tasks_by_file[path] = []
227	            titles[path] = _document_title(path, suffix)
228	
229	    for task in active_tasks:
230	        tasks_by_file[_primary_file(task, project_paths, area_paths)].append(task)
231	
232	    for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items():
233	        if path.name in {"已完成.md", "已取消.md"}:
234	            tasks.sort(key=_terminal_sort_key)
235	        else:
236	            tasks.sort(key=_primary_sort_key)
237	
238	    active_by_uuid = {task.uuid: task for task in active_tasks}
239	    warned_missing: Set[str] = set()
240	    tasks_by_file[Path("Today.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.today_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
241	    tasks_by_file[Path("Upcoming.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.upcoming_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
242	
243	    files = {path: render_document(titles[path], tasks) for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items()}
244	    return RenderedSnapshot(files=files, containers=containers)
245	
```
