"""Pure, deterministic rendering of Things snapshots into Markdown documents."""

import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Iterable, List, Sequence, Set, Tuple

from .markdown import render_document
from .models import ContainerPath, ContainerSnapshot, RenderedSnapshot, TaskSnapshot, ThingsSnapshot
from .utils import sanitize_path_segment


_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
_ROOT_FILES = (
    (Path("Inbox.md"), "Inbox"),
    (Path("Today.md"), "Today"),
    (Path("Anytime.md"), "Anytime"),
    (Path("Someday.md"), "Someday"),
    (Path("Upcoming.md"), "Upcoming"),
    (Path("已完成.md"), "已完成"),
    (Path("已取消.md"), "已取消"),
)
_CONTAINER_FILES = (
    ("tasks.md", "任务"),
    ("已完成.md", "已完成"),
    ("已取消.md", "已取消"),
)
_VALID_STARTS = {"Inbox", "Anytime", "Someday"}
_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH = 120


def _container_sort_key(container: ContainerSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, str]:
    return (container.title.casefold(), container.uuid)


def _suffix_segment(base: str, uuid: str, length: int, ordinal: int = 0) -> str:
    suffix = "-" + uuid[:length]
    if ordinal:
        suffix += "-" + str(ordinal)
    available = _MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH - len(suffix)
    if available <= 0:
        return suffix[-_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH:]
    return base[:available].rstrip(".").strip() + suffix


def _unique_suffix_lengths(containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], needs_suffix: Set[str]) -> Dict[str, int]:
    """Return UUID prefix lengths that distinguish suffixed peers."""
    lengths = {container.uuid: min(8, len(container.uuid)) for container in containers if container.uuid in needs_suffix}
    while True:
        groups: Dict[Tuple[str, str], List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
        for container in containers:
            if container.uuid not in needs_suffix:
                continue
            key = (bases[container.uuid].casefold(), container.uuid[:lengths[container.uuid]].casefold())
            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(container)
        duplicates = [group for group in groups.values() if len(group) > 1]
        if not duplicates:
            return lengths
        changed = False
        for group in duplicates:
            for container in group:
                current = lengths[container.uuid]
                if current < len(container.uuid):
                    lengths[container.uuid] = current + 1
                    changed = True
        if not changed:
            # UUIDs are unique, so this is defensive only for non-standard inputs.
            return lengths


def _collision_ordinals(
    containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], lengths: Dict[str, int], needs_suffix: Set[str]
) -> Dict[str, int]:
    """Assign stable ordinal suffixes to residual case-insensitive collisions."""
    candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
    for container in containers:
        segment = (
            _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
            if container.uuid in needs_suffix
            else bases[container.uuid]
        )
        candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)

    ordinals: Dict[str, int] = {}
    for group in candidates.values():
        if len(group) > 1:
            for ordinal, container in enumerate(sorted(group, key=_container_sort_key), start=1):
                ordinals[container.uuid] = ordinal
    return ordinals


def _allocate_kind(containers: Iterable[ContainerSnapshot], kind: str, root: str) -> List[ContainerPath]:
    active = sorted(
        (container for container in containers if not container.trashed),
        key=_container_sort_key,
    )
    bases = {
        container.uuid: sanitize_path_segment(container.title, "{}-{}".format(kind, container.uuid[:8]))
        for container in active
    }
    needs_suffix: Set[str] = set()

    # A case-insensitive duplicate cannot retain either clean segment.
    by_clean_name: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
    for container in active:
        by_clean_name.setdefault(bases[container.uuid].casefold(), []).append(container)
    for group in by_clean_name.values():
        if len(group) > 1:
            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)

    # A generated suffix can naturally be another container title.  Mark every
    # conflicting path for suffixing, then repeat until all candidates are unique.
    while True:
        lengths = _unique_suffix_lengths(active, bases, needs_suffix)
        candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
        for container in active:
            segment = (
                _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
                if container.uuid in needs_suffix
                else bases[container.uuid]
            )
            candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
        conflicts = [group for group in candidates.values() if len(group) > 1]
        if not conflicts:
            break
        previous_count = len(needs_suffix)
        for group in conflicts:
            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
        if len(needs_suffix) == previous_count:
            break

    ordinals = _collision_ordinals(active, bases, lengths, needs_suffix)
    paths = []
    used_segments: Set[str] = set()
    for container in active:
        if container.uuid in needs_suffix:
            ordinal = ordinals.get(container.uuid, 0)
            segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
                ordinal += 1
                segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
        else:
            segment = bases[container.uuid]
            ordinal = 0
            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
                ordinal += 1
                segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, len(container.uuid), ordinal)
        used_segments.add(segment.casefold())
        paths.append(ContainerPath(container.uuid, kind, Path(root) / segment))
    return paths


def allocate_container_paths(
    projects: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], areas: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot]
) -> Tuple[ContainerPath, ...]:
    """Allocate safe relative directories for active projects and areas."""
    paths = _allocate_kind(projects, "project", "Projects")
    paths.extend(_allocate_kind(areas, "area", "Areas"))
    return tuple(sorted(paths, key=lambda item: (item.kind, item.relative_dir.as_posix().casefold(), item.uuid)))


def _primary_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[int, str, str, str]:
    return (task.index, task.created or "", task.title.casefold(), task.uuid)


def _descending_text(value: str) -> str:
    return "".join(chr(0x10FFFF - ord(character)) for character in value)


def _terminal_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, int, str, str, str]:
    return (_descending_text(task.stop_date or ""),) + _primary_sort_key(task)


def _document_title(path: Path, suffix: str) -> str:
    if len(path.parts) == 1:
        return suffix
    return " / ".join(path.parts[:-1]) + " / " + suffix


def _primary_file(
    task: TaskSnapshot,
    project_paths: Dict[str, Path],
    area_paths: Dict[str, Path],
) -> Path:
    base = project_paths.get(task.project_uuid or "")
    if base is None:
        base = area_paths.get(task.area_uuid or "")
    if task.status == "completed":
        return base / "已完成.md" if base else Path("已完成.md")
    if task.status == "canceled":
        return base / "已取消.md" if base else Path("已取消.md")
    if base:
        return base / "tasks.md"
    if task.start not in _VALID_STARTS:
        _LOG.warning("Incomplete task %s has invalid or missing start %r; routing to Anytime", task.uuid, task.start)
        return Path("Anytime.md")
    return Path(task.start + ".md")


def _dynamic_tasks(
    uuids: Sequence[str], tasks: Dict[str, TaskSnapshot], warned: Set[str]
) -> List[TaskSnapshot]:
    selected = []
    for uuid in uuids:
        task = tasks.get(uuid)
        if task is None:
            if uuid not in warned:
                _LOG.warning("Dynamic view references missing task UUID %s", uuid)
                warned.add(uuid)
            continue
        selected.append(task)
    return selected


def render_snapshot(snapshot: ThingsSnapshot) -> RenderedSnapshot:
    """Render an immutable, entirely in-memory representation of a snapshot."""
    containers = allocate_container_paths(snapshot.projects, snapshot.areas)
    project_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "project"}
    area_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "area"}
    active_tasks = tuple(task for task in snapshot.tasks if not task.trashed)

    tasks_by_file: Dict[Path, List[TaskSnapshot]] = {path: [] for path, _ in _ROOT_FILES}
    titles: Dict[Path, str] = {path: title for path, title in _ROOT_FILES}
    for container in containers:
        for filename, suffix in _CONTAINER_FILES:
            path = container.relative_dir / filename
            tasks_by_file[path] = []
            titles[path] = _document_title(path, suffix)

    for task in active_tasks:
        tasks_by_file[_primary_file(task, project_paths, area_paths)].append(task)

    for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items():
        if path.name in {"已完成.md", "已取消.md"}:
            tasks.sort(key=_terminal_sort_key)
        else:
            tasks.sort(key=_primary_sort_key)

    active_by_uuid = {task.uuid: task for task in active_tasks}
    warned_missing: Set[str] = set()
    tasks_by_file[Path("Today.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.today_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
    tasks_by_file[Path("Upcoming.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.upcoming_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)

    files = {path: render_document(titles[path], tasks) for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items()}
    return RenderedSnapshot(files=files, containers=containers)
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from types import MappingProxyType
from typing import Literal, Mapping, Optional, Tuple

TaskStatus = Literal["incomplete", "completed", "canceled"]
ContainerKind = Literal["project", "area"]
ChangeKind = Literal["added", "modified", "deleted"]
_VALID_STATUSES = {"incomplete", "completed", "canceled"}

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ChecklistItem:
    uuid: str
    title: str
    status: TaskStatus
    stop_date: Optional[str] = None
    created: Optional[str] = None
    modified: Optional[str] = None
    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.status not in _VALID_STATUSES:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported checklist status: {self.status}")

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TaskSnapshot:
    uuid: str
    title: str
    status: TaskStatus
    task_type: str = "to-do"
    start: Optional[str] = None
    area_uuid: Optional[str] = None
    area_title: Optional[str] = None
    project_uuid: Optional[str] = None
    project_title: Optional[str] = None
    heading_uuid: Optional[str] = None
    heading_title: Optional[str] = None
    notes: Optional[str] = None
    tags: Tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    checklist: Tuple[ChecklistItem, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    start_date: Optional[str] = None
    deadline: Optional[str] = None
    reminder_time: Optional[str] = None
    stop_date: Optional[str] = None
    created: Optional[str] = None
    modified: Optional[str] = None
    index: int = 0
    today_index: int = 0
    trashed: bool = False
    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.status not in _VALID_STATUSES:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported task status: {self.status}")
        if self.task_type != "to-do":
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported task type: {self.task_type}")
        object.__setattr__(self, "tags", tuple(self.tags))
        object.__setattr__(self, "checklist", tuple(self.checklist))

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ContainerSnapshot:
    uuid: str
    kind: ContainerKind
    title: str
    area_uuid: Optional[str] = None
    area_title: Optional[str] = None
    index: int = 0
    trashed: bool = False

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ThingsSnapshot:
    tasks: Tuple[TaskSnapshot, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    projects: Tuple[ContainerSnapshot, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    areas: Tuple[ContainerSnapshot, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    today_uuids: Tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    upcoming_uuids: Tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for name in ("tasks", "projects", "areas", "today_uuids", "upcoming_uuids"):
            object.__setattr__(self, name, tuple(getattr(self, name)))
        task_ids = [task.uuid for task in self.tasks]
        container_ids = [c.uuid for c in self.projects + self.areas]
        if len(task_ids) != len(set(task_ids)):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate task UUID in snapshot")
        if len(container_ids) != len(set(container_ids)):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate container UUID in snapshot")

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ContainerPath:
    uuid: str
    kind: ContainerKind
    relative_dir: Path

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RenderedSnapshot:
    files: Mapping[Path, str]
    containers: Tuple[ContainerPath, ...]
    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(self, "files", MappingProxyType(dict(self.files)))
        object.__setattr__(self, "containers", tuple(self.containers))

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ChangeSet:
    added: Tuple[Path, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    modified: Tuple[Path, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    deleted: Tuple[Path, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    git_paths: Tuple[Path, ...] = field(default_factory=tuple)
    @property
    def paths(self) -> Tuple[Path, ...]:
        return tuple(sorted(set(self.added + self.modified + self.deleted)))
    @property
    def changed(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.paths)
    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for name in ("added", "modified", "deleted"):
            object.__setattr__(self, name, tuple(sorted(set(getattr(self, name)))))
        object.__setattr__(self, "git_paths", tuple(sorted(set(self.git_paths))))
        if not self.git_paths and self.paths:
            object.__setattr__(self, "git_paths", self.paths)

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SyncResult:
    changes: ChangeSet
    committed: bool = False
    pushed: bool = False

The supplied report records 30 passing tests and a clean `git diff --check`; those commands were not re-run.

10	## Findings
11	
12	### Important — collision resolution can emit duplicate container paths
13	
14	- **Location:** `src/renderer.py:105-115`
15	- **Failure scenario:** Two active containers have different UUIDs differing only by case (for example `AAAAAAAA` and `aaaaaaaa`) and titles that collide case-insensitively (for example `Release` and `release`). `_unique_suffix_lengths()` compares UUID prefixes with `.casefold()`. Once both prefixes have reached the full UUID length, it returns identical case-folded suffixes. The outer loop detects the collision, but since both members already have suffixes, `needs_suffix` does not grow and line 107 breaks. Both containers are then returned with the same case-insensitive path, so their generated documents overwrite one another in the `files` mapping.
16	- **Narrow remedy:** Make the disambiguator unique under the target filesystem comparison rule even for UUIDs that are equal case-insensitively. For example, retain an explicitly deterministic ordinal derived from the sorted collision group when full case-folded UUID prefixes still collide, and include it in the segment while preserving the 120-character limit. Continue collision resolution until every candidate `casefold()` path is unique rather than breaking with a collision.
17	
18	### Minor — test coverage omits the unresolvable-prefix collision boundary
19	
20	- **Location:** `tests/test_renderer.py:92-102`
21	- **Failure scenario:** The existing collision test exercises UUIDs sharing an eight-character prefix but eventually differing case-sensitively. It does not cover UUIDs that are distinct Python strings yet case-insensitively identical, which exposes the duplicate-path behavior above. Regression tests stay green while one container’s three documents disappear from `RenderedSnapshot.files`.
22	- **Narrow remedy:** Add a focused path-allocation test using `AAAAAAAA` and `aaaaaaaa` with case-colliding titles; assert unique `relative_dir.as_posix().casefold()` values and that rendering produces three documents for each container.

13	## Prior finding verification

15	The case-only UUID collision is fixed. For containers such as `AAAAAAAA` / `aaaaaaaa` with case-colliding titles, `_unique_suffix_lengths()` may still reach a residual case-insensitive collision, but `_collision_ordinals()` deterministically gives the stable sorted members different ordinal suffixes. The final `used_segments` loop then guarantees that every emitted segment is distinct under `casefold()`.
16	
17	Accordingly, `allocate_container_paths()` returns separate case-insensitive relative directories, and `render_snapshot()` creates three distinct document keys for each container (`tasks.md`, `已完成.md`, and `已取消.md`). The new regression test in `tests/test_renderer.py` verifies both properties.

21	## New finding
22	
23	### Important — UUID-derived suffixes bypass path-segment sanitization
24	
25	- **Location:** `/Users/oyamahappa/Documents/GitHub/Things3-push/src/renderer.py:35-42`, `:96-99`, and `:135-146`
26	- **Problem:** Container titles are passed through `sanitize_path_segment()`, but `_suffix_segment()` appends raw UUID text. The fallback passed to `sanitize_path_segment()` also embeds the raw UUID. Neither location sanitizes UUID-derived text before it becomes a path segment.
27	- **Failure scenario:** A `ContainerSnapshot` with a UUID containing a path separator or traversal component, combined with any case-insensitive title collision that causes suffix allocation, can yield a `relative_dir` containing additional components or `..`. For example, a UUID of `../TARGET` can produce a segment shaped like `Release-../TARGET`; `Path("Projects") / segment` is then not a single safe segment beneath `Projects`. A writer that joins this nominally relative path to its output root can resolve outside the intended container directory.
28	- **Impact:** This violates Task 4's requirement that rendered mapping keys are safe relative `Path` values without `..`, as well as the report's claim that all path segments are sanitized. The 120-character length handling does not remove separators or traversal components.
29	- **Narrow remedy:** Derive a path-safe UUID token before using it in either fallbacks or suffixes (for example, a sanitizer dedicated to UUID tokens that removes path separators and rejects/normalizes `.` and `..`). Apply the 120-character bound to the final one-component segment and add a regression test using separator/traversal-bearing UUID input in a collision path.

33	- The ordinal suffix mechanism retains the 120-character maximum for a single resulting segment, including ordinal suffixes.
34	- The collision repair preserves deterministic allocation and does not reintroduce overwriting of container document groups for UUIDs differing only by case.

9	
10	_STATUS_MARKERS = {

14	}

17	
18	def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
19	    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
20	    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
21	    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
22	    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
23	    escaped = []
24	    for character in normalized:
25	        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
26	            escaped.append("\\")
27	        escaped.append(character)
28	    return "".join(escaped)
29	
30	
31	def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
32	    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
33	
34	
35	def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
36	    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
37	
38	
39	def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
40	    rendered = []
41	    for tag in tags:
42	        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
43	        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
44	        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
45	    return " ".join(rendered)
46	
47	
48	def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
49	    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
50	    lines = normalized.split("\n")
51	    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
52	        lines.pop()
53	    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
54	        return ()
55	    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
56	
57

59	    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
60	    if item.stop_date:
61	        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
62	    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)

65	def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
66	    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
67	    lines = [
68	        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
69	        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
70	    ]
71	
72	    fields = (

79	        ("领域", task.area_title),
80	        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
81	    )
82	    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
83	
84	    if task.tags:
85	        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
86	
87	    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
88	    if note_lines:
89	        lines.append("- **备注**:")
90	        lines.extend(note_lines)
91	
92	    if task.checklist:
93	        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
94	        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
95	
96	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
97	
98	
99	def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
100	    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
101	    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
102	    if not tasks:
103	        return header
104	
105	    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
106	    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"

110	    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""

130	    # conflicting path for suffixing, then repeat until all candidates are unique.
131	    while True:
132	        lengths = _unique_suffix_lengths(active, bases, needs_suffix)
133	        candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
134	        for container in active:
135	            segment = (
136	                _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
137	                if container.uuid in needs_suffix
138	                else bases[container.uuid]
139	            )
140	            candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
141	        conflicts = [group for group in candidates.values() if len(group) > 1]
142	        if not conflicts:
143	            break
144	        previous_count = len(needs_suffix)
145	        for group in conflicts:
146	            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
147	        if len(needs_suffix) == previous_count:
148	            break
149	
150	    ordinals = _collision_ordinals(active, bases, lengths, needs_suffix)
151	    paths = []
152	    used_segments: Set[str] = set()
153	    for container in active:
154	        if container.uuid in needs_suffix:
155	            ordinal = ordinals.get(container.uuid, 0)
156	            segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
157	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
158	                ordinal += 1
159	                segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
160	        else:
161	            segment = bases[container.uuid]
162	            ordinal = 0
163	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
164	                ordinal += 1
165	                segment = _suffix_segment(
166	                    bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, len(_uuid_token(container.uuid)), ordinal
167	                )
168	        used_segments.add(segment.casefold())
169	        paths.append(ContainerPath(container.uuid, kind, Path(root) / segment))
170	    return paths
171	
172	
173	def allocate_container_paths(
174	    projects: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], areas: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot]
175	) -> Tuple[ContainerPath, ...]:
176	    """Allocate safe relative directories for active projects and areas."""
177	    paths = _allocate_kind(projects, "project", "Projects")
178	    paths.extend(_allocate_kind(areas, "area", "Areas"))
179	    return tuple(sorted(paths, key=lambda item: (item.kind, item.relative_dir.as_posix().casefold(), item.uuid)))
180	
181	
182	def _primary_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[int, str, str, str]:
183	    return (task.index, task.created or "", task.title.casefold(), task.uuid)
184	
185	
186	def _descending_text(value: str) -> str:
187	    return "".join(chr(0x10FFFF - ord(character)) for character in value)
188	
189	
190	def _terminal_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, int, str, str, str]:
191	    return (_descending_text(task.stop_date or ""),) + _primary_sort_key(task)
192	
193	
194	def _document_title(path: Path, suffix: str) -> str:
195	    if len(path.parts) == 1:
196	        return suffix
197	    return " / ".join(path.parts[:-1]) + " / " + suffix
198	
199	
200	def _primary_file(
201	    task: TaskSnapshot,
202	    project_paths: Dict[str, Path],
203	    area_paths: Dict[str, Path],
204	) -> Path:
205	    base = project_paths.get(task.project_uuid or "")
206	    if base is None:
207	        base = area_paths.get(task.area_uuid or "")
208	    if task.status == "completed":
209	        return base / "已完成.md" if base else Path("已完成.md")
210	    if task.status == "canceled":
211	        return base / "已取消.md" if base else Path("已取消.md")
212	    if base:
213	        return base / "tasks.md"
214	    if task.start not in _VALID_STARTS:
215	        _LOG.warning("Incomplete task %s has invalid or missing start %r; routing to Anytime", task.uuid, task.start)
216	        return Path("Anytime.md")
217	    return Path(task.start + ".md")
218	
219	
220	def _dynamic_tasks(
221	    uuids: Sequence[str], tasks: Dict[str, TaskSnapshot], warned: Set[str]
222	) -> List[TaskSnapshot]:
223	    selected = []
224	    for uuid in uuids:
225	        task = tasks.get(uuid)
226	        if task is None:
227	            if uuid not in warned:
228	                _LOG.warning("Dynamic view references missing task UUID %s", uuid)
229	                warned.add(uuid)
230	            continue
231	        selected.append(task)
232	    return selected
233	
234	
235	def render_snapshot(snapshot: ThingsSnapshot) -> RenderedSnapshot:
236	    """Render an immutable, entirely in-memory representation of a snapshot."""
237	    containers = allocate_container_paths(snapshot.projects, snapshot.areas)
238	    project_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "project"}
239	    area_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "area"}
240	    active_tasks = tuple(task for task in snapshot.tasks if not task.trashed)
241	
242	    tasks_by_file: Dict[Path, List[TaskSnapshot]] = {path: [] for path, _ in _ROOT_FILES}
243	    titles: Dict[Path, str] = {path: title for path, title in _ROOT_FILES}
244	    for container in containers:
245	        for filename, suffix in _CONTAINER_FILES:
246	            path = container.relative_dir / filename
247	            tasks_by_file[path] = []
248	            titles[path] = _document_title(path, suffix)
249	
250	    for task in active_tasks:
251	        tasks_by_file[_primary_file(task, project_paths, area_paths)].append(task)
252	
253	    for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items():
254	        if path.name in {"已完成.md", "已取消.md"}:
255	            tasks.sort(key=_terminal_sort_key)
256	        else:
257	            tasks.sort(key=_primary_sort_key)
258	
259	    active_by_uuid = {task.uuid: task for task in active_tasks}
260	    warned_missing: Set[str] = set()
261	    tasks_by_file[Path("Today.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.today_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
262	    tasks_by_file[Path("Upcoming.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.upcoming_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
263	
264	    files = {path: render_document(titles[path], tasks) for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items()}
265	    return RenderedSnapshot(files=files, containers=containers)
266	
```

171	+def _safe_relative_path(repo_path: Path, relative_path: Path) -> bool:

207	+    if not manifest_path.exists():

242	+        ),

261	+def _atomic_write(path: Path, content: str) -> None:
262	+    """Replace a UTF-8 text file atomically with a sibling temporary file."""
263	+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

282	+            try:

284	+            except FileNotFoundError:
285	+                pass

31	def _container_sort_key(container: ContainerSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, str]:
32	    return (container.title.casefold(), container.uuid)
33	
34	
35	def _uuid_token(uuid: str) -> str:
36	    """Return a deterministic, one-segment-safe representation of a UUID."""
37	    token = []
38	    for character in uuid:
39	        if character.isascii() and (character.isalnum() or character in "-_"):
40	            token.append(character)
41	        else:
42	            token.extend("x{:02x}".format(byte) for byte in character.encode("utf-8"))
43	    return "".join(token) or "uuid"
44	
45	
46	def _suffix_segment(base: str, uuid: str, length: int, ordinal: int = 0) -> str:
47	    suffix = "-" + _uuid_token(uuid)[:length]
48	    if ordinal:
49	        suffix += "-" + str(ordinal)
50	    available = _MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH - len(suffix)
51	    if available <= 0:
52	        return suffix[-_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH:]
53	    return base[:available].rstrip(".").strip() + suffix
54	
55	
56	def _unique_suffix_lengths(containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], needs_suffix: Set[str]) -> Dict[str, int]:
57	    """Return UUID prefix lengths that distinguish suffixed peers."""
58	    lengths = {
59	        container.uuid: min(8, len(_uuid_token(container.uuid)))
60	        for container in containers
61	        if container.uuid in needs_suffix
62	    }
63	    while True:
64	        groups: Dict[Tuple[str, str], List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
65	        for container in containers:
66	            if container.uuid not in needs_suffix:
67	                continue
68	            token = _uuid_token(container.uuid)
69	            key = (bases[container.uuid].casefold(), token[:lengths[container.uuid]].casefold())
70	            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(container)
71	        duplicates = [group for group in groups.values() if len(group) > 1]
72	        if not duplicates:
73	            return lengths
74	        changed = False
75	        for group in duplicates:
76	            for container in group:
77	                current = lengths[container.uuid]
78	                token = _uuid_token(container.uuid)
79	                if current < len(token):
80	                    lengths[container.uuid] = current + 1
81	                    changed = True
82	        if not changed:
83	            # UUIDs are unique, so this is defensive only for non-standard inputs.
84	            return lengths
85	
86	
87	def _collision_ordinals(
88	    containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], lengths: Dict[str, int], needs_suffix: Set[str]
89	) -> Dict[str, int]:
90	    """Assign stable ordinal suffixes to residual case-insensitive collisions."""
91	    candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
92	    for container in containers:
93	        segment = (
94	            _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
95	            if container.uuid in needs_suffix
96	            else bases[container.uuid]
97	        )
98	        candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
99	
100	    ordinals: Dict[str, int] = {}
101	    for group in candidates.values():
102	        if len(group) > 1:
103	            for ordinal, container in enumerate(sorted(group, key=_container_sort_key), start=1):
104	                ordinals[container.uuid] = ordinal
105	    return ordinals
106	
107	
108	def _allocate_kind(containers: Iterable[ContainerSnapshot], kind: str, root: str) -> List[ContainerPath]:
109	    active = sorted(
110	        (container for container in containers if not container.trashed),
111	        key=_container_sort_key,
112	    )
113	    bases = {
114	        container.uuid: sanitize_path_segment(
115	            container.title, "{}-{}".format(kind, _uuid_token(container.uuid)[:8])
116	        )
117	        for container in active
118	    }
119	    needs_suffix: Set[str] = set()
120	
121	    # A case-insensitive duplicate cannot retain either clean segment.
122	    by_clean_name: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
123	    for container in active:
124	        by_clean_name.setdefault(bases[container.uuid].casefold(), []).append(container)
125	    for group in by_clean_name.values():
126	        if len(group) > 1:
127	            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
128	
129	    # A generated suffix can naturally be another container title.  Mark every
130	    # conflicting path for suffixing, then repeat until all candidates are unique.
131	    while True:
132	        lengths = _unique_suffix_lengths(active, bases, needs_suffix)
133	        candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
134	        for container in active:
135	            segment = (
136	                _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
137	                if container.uuid in needs_suffix
138	                else bases[container.uuid]
139	            )
140	            candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
141	        conflicts = [group for group in candidates.values() if len(group) > 1]
142	        if not conflicts:
143	            break
144	        previous_count = len(needs_suffix)
145	        for group in conflicts:
146	            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
147	        if len(needs_suffix) == previous_count:
148	            break
149	
150	    ordinals = _collision_ordinals(active, bases, lengths, needs_suffix)
151	    paths = []
152	    used_segments: Set[str] = set()
153	    for container in active:
154	        if container.uuid in needs_suffix:
155	            ordinal = ordinals.get(container.uuid, 0)
156	            segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
157	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
158	                ordinal += 1
159	                segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
160	        else:
161	            segment = bases[container.uuid]
162	            ordinal = 0
163	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
164	                ordinal += 1
165	                segment = _suffix_segment(
166	                    bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, len(_uuid_token(container.uuid)), ordinal
167	                )
168	        used_segments.add(segment.casefold())
169	        paths.append(ContainerPath(container.uuid, kind, Path(root) / segment))
170	    return paths
171	
172	
173	def allocate_container_paths(
174	    projects: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], areas: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot]
175	) -> Tuple[ContainerPath, ...]:
176	    """Allocate safe relative directories for active projects and areas."""
177	    paths = _allocate_kind(projects, "project", "Projects")
178	    paths.extend(_allocate_kind(areas, "area", "Areas"))
179	    return tuple(sorted(paths, key=lambda item: (item.kind, item.relative_dir.as_posix().casefold(), item.uuid)))
180	
181	
182	def _primary_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[int, str, str, str]:
183	    return (task.index, task.created or "", task.title.casefold(), task.uuid)
184	
185	
186	def _descending_text(value: str) -> str:
187	    return "".join(chr(0x10FFFF - ord(character)) for character in value)
188	
189	
190	def _terminal_sort_key(task: TaskSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, int, str, str, str]:
191	    return (_descending_text(task.stop_date or ""),) + _primary_sort_key(task)
192	
193	
194	def _document_title(path: Path, suffix: str) -> str:
195	    if len(path.parts) == 1:
196	        return suffix
197	    return " / ".join(path.parts[:-1]) + " / " + suffix
198	
199	
200	def _primary_file(
201	    task: TaskSnapshot,
202	    project_paths: Dict[str, Path],
203	    area_paths: Dict[str, Path],
204	) -> Path:
205	    base = project_paths.get(task.project_uuid or "")
206	    if base is None:
207	        base = area_paths.get(task.area_uuid or "")
208	    if task.status == "completed":
209	        return base / "已完成.md" if base else Path("已完成.md")
210	    if task.status == "canceled":
211	        return base / "已取消.md" if base else Path("已取消.md")
212	    if base:
213	        return base / "tasks.md"
214	    if task.start not in _VALID_STARTS:
215	        _LOG.warning("Incomplete task %s has invalid or missing start %r; routing to Anytime", task.uuid, task.start)
216	        return Path("Anytime.md")
217	    return Path(task.start + ".md")
218	
219	
220	def _dynamic_tasks(
221	    uuids: Sequence[str], tasks: Dict[str, TaskSnapshot], warned: Set[str]
222	) -> List[TaskSnapshot]:
223	    selected = []
224	    for uuid in uuids:
225	        task = tasks.get(uuid)
226	        if task is None:
227	            if uuid not in warned:
228	                _LOG.warning("Dynamic view references missing task UUID %s", uuid)
229	                warned.add(uuid)
230	            continue
231	        selected.append(task)
232	    return selected
233	
234	
235	def render_snapshot(snapshot: ThingsSnapshot) -> RenderedSnapshot:
236	    """Render an immutable, entirely in-memory representation of a snapshot."""
237	    containers = allocate_container_paths(snapshot.projects, snapshot.areas)
238	    project_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "project"}
239	    area_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "area"}
240	    active_tasks = tuple(task for task in snapshot.tasks if not task.trashed)
241	
242	    tasks_by_file: Dict[Path, List[TaskSnapshot]] = {path: [] for path, _ in _ROOT_FILES}
243	    titles: Dict[Path, str] = {path: title for path, title in _ROOT_FILES}
244	    for container in containers:
245	        for filename, suffix in _CONTAINER_FILES:
246	            path = container.relative_dir / filename
247	            tasks_by_file[path] = []
248	            titles[path] = _document_title(path, suffix)
249	
250	    for task in active_tasks:
251	        tasks_by_file[_primary_file(task, project_paths, area_paths)].append(task)
252	
253	    for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items():
254	        if path.name in {"已完成.md", "已取消.md"}:
255	            tasks.sort(key=_terminal_sort_key)
256	        else:
257	            tasks.sort(key=_primary_sort_key)
258	
259	    active_by_uuid = {task.uuid: task for task in active_tasks}
260	    warned_missing: Set[str] = set()
261	    tasks_by_file[Path("Today.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.today_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
262	    tasks_by_file[Path("Upcoming.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.upcoming_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
263	
264	    files = {path: render_document(titles[path], tasks) for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items()}
265	    return RenderedSnapshot(files=files, containers=containers)
266	
```

18	def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
19	    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
20	    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
21	    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")

23	    escaped = []

25	        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:

27	        escaped.append(character)
28	    return "".join(escaped)
29	
30	
31	def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
32	    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
33	
34	
35	def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
36	    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
37	
38	
39	def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
40	    rendered = []
41	    for tag in tags:
42	        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
43	        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
44	        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
45	    return " ".join(rendered)
46	
47	
48	def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
49	    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
50	    lines = normalized.split("\n")
51	    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
52	        lines.pop()
53	    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
54	        return ()
55	    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
56	
57	
58	def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
59	    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
60	    if item.stop_date:
61	        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
62	    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
63	
64	
65	def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
66	    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
67	    lines = [
68	        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
69	        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
70	    ]
71	
72	    fields = (
73	        ("创建时间", task.created),
74	        ("修改时间", task.modified),
75	        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
76	        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
77	        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
78	        ("项目", task.project_title),
79	        ("领域", task.area_title),
80	        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
81	    )
82	    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
83	
84	    if task.tags:
85	        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
86	
87	    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
88	    if note_lines:
89	        lines.append("- **备注**:")
90	        lines.extend(note_lines)
91	
92	    if task.checklist:
93	        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
94	        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
95	
96	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
97	
98	
99	def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
100	    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
101	    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
102	    if not tasks:
103	        return header
104	
105	    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
106	    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"
107	
108	
109	def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
110	    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
111	    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
112	    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER
113	
```

166	
167	def safe_git_operation(repo_path: Path, command: list) -> bool:
168	    """
169	    执行 Git 命令，记录错误但不中断主流程
170	  
171	    Returns:
172	        bool: 操作是否成功
173	    """
174	    try:
175	        result = subprocess.run(
176	            command,
177	            cwd=repo_path,
178	            capture_output=True,
179	            text=True,
180	            timeout=30,
181	            check=True
182	        )
183	        logging.info(f"Git command success: {' '.join(command)}")
184	        return True
185	    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
186	        logging.error(f"Git command failed: {e.stderr}")
187	        return False
188	    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
189	        logging.error(f"Git command timeout: {' '.join(command)}")
190	        return False

Serialize with `ensure_ascii=False`, `indent=2`, `sort_keys=True`, and one trailing newline.

141	A relative path is safe only if it is nonempty, not absolute, contains no `..` component, and resolves under `repo_path` via `Path.resolve().is_relative_to(repo_path.resolve())`. 143	- [ ] **Step 5: Implement atomic writes and basic reconciliation**
144	
145	`_atomic_write(path, content)` must:
146	
147	1. Create parents with `mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)`.
148	2. Use `tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n", dir=path.parent, prefix=f".{path.name}.", suffix=".tmp", delete=False)`.
149	3. Write, flush, and `os.fsync` the descriptor.
150	4. Call `os.replace(temp_path, path)`.
151	5. In `finally`, unlink the temporary path if it still exists.
152	
153	`reconcile` validates every desired path before touching disk, loads the previous manifest, and performs a complete preflight over all desired destinations. A destination may be written only when it is absent, already listed in the previous manifest, or its existing first line matches `GENERATED_MARKER`; an existing unmarked destination raises `FileExistsError` before any write. After preflight, compare exact UTF-8 text, write added/modified desired files in sorted path order, then handle stale files from the prior manifest. A stale Markdown file is deleted only when its first line matches `GENERATED_MARKER`; stale manifest-owned JSON is managed by schema rather than the Markdown marker. Remove empty directories only by walking known old container directories upward until `Projects`, `Areas`, or repository root, and only when `rmdir()` succeeds.
154	
155	Write the new manifest last. If the manifest content itself is unchanged, do not rewrite it. Return sorted tuples in `ChangeSet`. Set `git_paths` to the sorted union of the previous manifest's managed paths, the new manifest's managed paths, the manifest path itself, and every added/modified/deleted path. This broader, still-explicit pathspec lets a later sync detect and commit managed working-tree changes left behind by an earlier Git failure even when no file needs rewriting on that later run.

220	def reconcile(repo_path: Path, rendered: RenderedSnapshot) -> ChangeSet:
221	    """Reconcile managed files, preserving unowned paths and writing manifest last."""
222	    repo_path = Path(repo_path)
223	    desired = dict(rendered.files)

232	    for relative_path in sorted(desired):

235	    desired_paths = tuple(sorted(desired))

238	        active_containers=active_containers,

240	    )

111	Add tests asserting that absolute paths and paths containing `..` raise `ValueError` before any disk mutation. Patch the private `_atomic_write` on the second output and assert no Git-facing `ChangeSet` is returned; the first successful file may exist, the old second file remains intact, and the next unpatched `reconcile` converges.
112	
113	Patch `os.replace` for a single file to raise `OSError`; verify its original content remains and a `.tmp` file is not left behind.

117	```bash
118	python3 -m pytest tests/test_filesystem.py -v
119	```

123	- [ ] **Step 4: Implement manifest schema and safe loading**
124	
125	Manifest JSON schema version 1:
126	
127	```json
128	{
129	  "_generated_by": "things3-github-sync",
130	  "version": 1,
131	  "managed_files": ["Inbox.md"],
132	  "active_containers": {
133	    "project:P1": "Projects/Release"
134	  },
135	  "archived_containers": {}
136	}
137	```
138	
139	Create frozen `Manifest` with tuple/mapping fields. `load_manifest` returns an empty version-1 manifest if absent. If JSON is malformed, marker is wrong, version is unsupported, paths are unsafe, or types are invalid, raise `ValueError` and perform no writes. Serialize with `ensure_ascii=False`, `indent=2`, `sort_keys=True`, and one trailing newline.
140	
141	A relative path is safe only if it is nonempty, not absolute, contains no `..` component, and resolves under `repo_path` via `Path.resolve().is_relative_to(repo_path.resolve())`. Because Python 3.9 lacks `Path.is_relative_to`, implement a private helper using `candidate.relative_to(root)` inside `try/except ValueError`.
142	
143	- [ ] **Step 5: Implement atomic writes and basic reconciliation**
144	
145	`_atomic_write(path, content)` must:
146	
147	1. Create parents with `mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)`.
148	2. Use `tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n", dir=path.parent, prefix=f".{path.name}.", suffix=".tmp", delete=False)`.
149	3. Write, flush, and `os.fsync` the descriptor.
150	4. Call `os.replace(temp_path, path)`.
151	5. In `finally`, unlink the temporary path if it still exists.
152	
153	`reconcile` validates every desired path before touching disk, loads the previous manifest, and performs a complete preflight over all desired destinations. A destination may be written only when it is absent, already listed in the previous manifest, or its existing first line matches `GENERATED_MARKER`; an existing unmarked destination raises `FileExistsError` before any write. After preflight, compare exact UTF-8 text, write added/modified desired files in sorted path order, then handle stale files from the prior manifest. A stale Markdown file is deleted only when its first line matches `GENERATED_MARKER`; stale manifest-owned JSON is managed by schema rather than the Markdown marker. Remove empty directories only by walking known old container directories upward until `Projects`, `Areas`, or repository root, and only when `rmdir()` succeeds.
154	
155	Write the new manifest last. If the manifest content itself is unchanged, do not rewrite it. Return sorted tuples in `ChangeSet`. Set `git_paths` to the sorted union of the previous manifest's managed paths, the new manifest's managed paths, the manifest path itself, and every added/modified/deleted path. This broader, still-explicit pathspec lets a later sync detect and commit managed working-tree changes left behind by an earlier Git failure even when no file needs rewriting on that later run.
156

138	def _atomic_write(path: Path, content: str) -> None:
139	    """Replace a UTF-8 text file atomically with a sibling temporary file."""
140	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
141	    temporary_path = None
142	    try:
143	        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
144	            mode="w",
145	            encoding="utf-8",
146	            newline="\n",
147	            dir=path.parent,
148	            prefix=".{}.".format(path.name),
149	            suffix=".tmp",
150	            delete=False,
151	        ) as temporary_file:
152	            temporary_path = Path(temporary_file.name)
153	            temporary_file.write(content)
154	            temporary_file.flush()
155	            os.fsync(temporary_file.fileno())
156	        os.replace(temporary_path, path)
157	    finally:
158	        if temporary_path is not None:
159	            try:
160	                temporary_path.unlink()
161	            except FileNotFoundError:
162	                pass
163	
164	
165	def _read_text(path: Path) -> str:
166	    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
167	
168	
169	def _remove_empty_container_directories(repo_path: Path, containers: Mapping[str, Path]) -> None:
170	    root = repo_path.resolve()
171	    stop_names = {"Projects", "Areas"}
172	    for relative_dir in set(containers.values()):
173	        current = repo_path / relative_dir
174	        while current != repo_path and current.name not in stop_names:
175	            try:
176	                current.rmdir()
177	            except OSError:
178	                break
179	            current = current.parent
180	        if current.resolve() == root:
181	            continue
182	
183	
184	def _container_mapping(repo_path: Path, rendered: RenderedSnapshot) -> Mapping[str, Path]:
185	    containers = {}
186	    for container in rendered.containers:
187	        relative_dir = container.relative_dir
188	        _require_safe_path(repo_path, relative_dir)
189	        key = "{}:{}".format(container.kind, container.uuid)
190	        if key in containers and containers[key] != relative_dir:
191	            raise ValueError("duplicate container identity: {}".format(key))
192	        containers[key] = relative_dir
193	    return containers
194	
195	
196	def _preflight_manifest_destination(repo_path: Path) -> None:
197	    """Reject non-regular manifest entries without following symlinks."""
198	    manifest_path = repo_path / MANIFEST_PATH
199	    if not os.path.lexists(str(manifest_path)):
200	        return
201	    if manifest_path.is_symlink() or not manifest_path.is_file():
202	        raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(MANIFEST_PATH))
203	
204	
205	def _preflight_destination(repo_path: Path, relative_path: Path, previous: Manifest) -> None:
206	    """Ensure every existing destination component is safe before writes begin."""
207	    destination = repo_path / relative_path
208	    current = repo_path
209	    for component in relative_path.parts:
210	        current = current / component
211	        if not os.path.lexists(str(current)):
212	            continue
213	        if current.is_symlink():
214	            raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path))
215	        if current == destination:
216	            if not current.is_file():
217	                raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path))
218	            if relative_path in previous.managed_files:
219	                return
220	            try:
221	                managed = is_managed_markdown(_read_text(current))
222	            except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as error:
223	                raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path)) from error
224	            if not managed:
225	                raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path))
226	            return
227	        if not current.is_dir():
228	            raise FileExistsError("unmanaged destination: {!s}".format(relative_path))
229	
230	
231	def reconcile(repo_path: Path, rendered: RenderedSnapshot) -> ChangeSet:
232	    """Reconcile managed files, preserving unowned paths and writing manifest last."""
233	    repo_path = Path(repo_path)
234	    desired = dict(rendered.files)
235	    for relative_path, content in desired.items():
236	        if not isinstance(relative_path, Path) or not isinstance(content, str):
237	            raise ValueError("rendered files must map paths to text")
238	        _require_safe_path(repo_path, relative_path)
239	    active_containers = _container_mapping(repo_path, rendered)
240	    _preflight_manifest_destination(repo_path)
241	    previous = load_manifest(repo_path)
242	
243	    # Complete ownership preflight must finish before the first filesystem mutation.
244	    for relative_path in sorted(desired):
245	        _preflight_destination(repo_path, relative_path, previous)
246	
247	    desired_paths = tuple(sorted(desired))
248	    new_manifest = Manifest(
249	        managed_files=desired_paths,
250	        active_containers=active_containers,
251	        archived_containers=previous.archived_containers,
252	    )
253	    added = []
254	    modified = []
255	    deleted = []
256	    for relative_path in desired_paths:
257	        destination = repo_path / relative_path
258	        if not destination.exists():
259	            _atomic_write(destination, desired[relative_path])
260	            added.append(relative_path)
261	        elif _read_text(destination) != desired[relative_path]:
262	            _atomic_write(destination, desired[relative_path])
263	            modified.append(relative_path)
264	
265	    for relative_path in previous.managed_files:
266	        if relative_path in desired:
267	            continue
268	        stale_path = repo_path / relative_path
269	        if not stale_path.exists():
270	            continue
271	        if stale_path.is_file() and is_managed_markdown(_read_text(stale_path)):
272	            stale_path.unlink()
273	            deleted.append(relative_path)
274	        else:
275	            _LOG.warning("Not deleting unmarked file: %s", relative_path)
276	    _remove_empty_container_directories(repo_path, previous.active_containers)
277	
278	    manifest_path = repo_path / MANIFEST_PATH
279	    manifest_content = _manifest_content(new_manifest)
280	    if not manifest_path.exists():
281	        _atomic_write(manifest_path, manifest_content)
282	        added.append(MANIFEST_PATH)
283	    elif _read_text(manifest_path) != manifest_content:
284	        _atomic_write(manifest_path, manifest_content)
285	        modified.append(MANIFEST_PATH)
286	
287	    git_paths = set(previous.managed_files) | set(new_manifest.managed_files)
288	    git_paths.add(MANIFEST_PATH)
289	    git_paths.update(added)
290	    git_paths.update(modified)
291	    git_paths.update(deleted)
292	    return ChangeSet(added=tuple(added), modified=tuple(modified), deleted=tuple(deleted), git_paths=tuple(git_paths))
293	
```

2

14	}
15	_INLINE_SPECIALS = "\\`*_[]<>"
16	
17	
18	def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
19	    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
20	    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
21	    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
22	    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
23	    escaped = []
24	    for character in normalized:
25	        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
26	            escaped.append("\\")
27	        escaped.append(character)

31	def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:

37

40	    rendered = []
41	    for tag in tags:
42	        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
43	        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
44	        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
45	    return " ".join(rendered)
46

49	    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
50	    lines = normalized.split("\n")
51	    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
52	        lines.pop()
53	    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
54	        return ()
55	    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
56	
57

59	    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
60	    if item.stop_date:
61	        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
62	    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)

65	def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
66	    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""

68	        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
69	        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),

79	        ("领域", task.area_title),
80	        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
81	    )

83	
84	    if task.tags:
85	        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
86	
87	    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
88	    if note_lines:

90	        lines.extend(note_lines)
91	
92	    if task.checklist:
93	        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
94	        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
95	
96	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
97

99	def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
100	    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
101	    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
102	    if not tasks:
103	        return header
104	
105	    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
106	    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"

110	    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""

112	    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER

20	_SECRET_VALUE_RE = re.compile(r"(?i)\b(token|auth-token|password)=([^&#\s]+)")

38	def _redact_url(match: re.Match) -> str:
39	    value = match.group(0)
40	    parsed = urlsplit(value)
41	    if "@" not in parsed.netloc:
42	        return value
43	    userinfo, host = parsed.netloc.rsplit("@", 1)
44	    if not userinfo:
45	        return value
46	    return urlunsplit((parsed.scheme, "***@" + host, parsed.path, parsed.query, parsed.fragment))
47

49	def _redact_credentials(text: str) -> str:
50	    """Remove credentials from URL userinfo and common credential parameters."""
51	    redacted = _URL_RE.sub(_redact_url, text)
52	    return _SECRET_VALUE_RE.sub(lambda match: "{}=***".format(match.group(1)), redacted)

77	        else:

149	        pathspecs = _path_strings(paths)
150	        if not pathspecs:
151	            return False
152	        descriptor, index_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="things3-sync-index-")
153	        os.close(descriptor)
154	        index_path = Path(index_name)
155	        try:
156	            index_path.unlink()
157	            index_env = {"GIT_INDEX_FILE": str(index_path)}
158	            seeded = self._run(["read-tree", "HEAD"], index_env)
159	            if seeded is None or seeded.returncode != 0:
160	                return False
161	            staged = self._run(["add", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
162	            if staged is None or staged.returncode != 0:
163	                return False
164	            diff = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--quiet", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
165	            if diff is None or diff.returncode == 0:
166	                return False
167	            if diff.returncode != 1:
168	                return False
169	            self._commit_found_diff = True
170	            name_status = self._run(["diff", "--cached", "--name-status", "-z", "--"] + list(pathspecs), index_env)
171	            if name_status is None or name_status.returncode != 0:
172	                return False
173	            counts = _counts_from_name_status(name_status.stdout)
174	            message = generate_commit_message(counts, now or datetime.now())
175	            committed = self._run(["commit", "-m", message], index_env)
176	            if committed is None or committed.returncode != 0:
177	                return False
178	        finally:
179	            try:
180	                index_path.unlink()
181	            except FileNotFoundError:
182	                pass
183	
184	        refreshed = self._run(["reset", "-q", "HEAD", "--"] + list(pathspecs))
185	        if refreshed is None or refreshed.returncode != 0:
186	            _LOG.error("Managed paths committed but real-index refresh failed")
187	            return False
188	        return True
189	
190	    def commit(self, changes: ChangeSet, paths: Sequence[Path], now: Optional[datetime] = None) -> bool:
191	        """Commit managed paths through an isolated temporary index."""
192	        del changes
193	        return self._isolated_commit(paths, now)
194	
195	    def push(self, remote: str, branch: str) -> bool:
196	        result = self._run(["push", remote, branch])
197	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
198	
199	    def pending_push(self) -> bool:
200	        result = self._run(["show-ref", "--verify", "--quiet", PENDING_PUSH_REF])
201	        if result is None:
202	            return False
203	        if result.returncode == 0:
204	            return True
205	        if result.returncode != 1:
206	            _LOG.error("Could not determine pending push state")
207	        return False
208	
209	    def _mark_pending_push(self) -> bool:
210	        result = self._run(["update-ref", PENDING_PUSH_REF, "HEAD"])
211	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
212	
213	    def _clear_pending_push(self) -> bool:
214	        result = self._run(["update-ref", "-d", PENDING_PUSH_REF])
215	        return result is not None and result.returncode == 0
216	
217	    def sync(
218	        self,
219	        changes: ChangeSet,
220	        auto_commit: bool,
221	        auto_push: bool,
222	        remote: str,
223	        branch: str,
224	        now: Optional[datetime] = None,
225	    ) -> Tuple[bool, bool]:
226	        """Commit managed changes and push only a durably marked sync commit."""
227	        if auto_push and not auto_commit:
228	            raise ValueError("AUTO_PUSH requires AUTO_COMMIT")
229	        if not auto_commit:
230	            return (False, False)
231	
232	        paths = changes.git_paths
233	        committed = False
234	        pending = False
235	        if paths:
236	            self._commit_found_diff = False
237	            committed = self.commit(changes, paths, now)
238	            if self._commit_found_diff and not committed:
239	                return (False, False)
240	            if committed:
241	                if not self._mark_pending_push():
242	                    return (False, False)
243	                pending = True
244	        if not pending and auto_push:
245	            pending = self.pending_push()
246	        if not auto_push or not pending:
247	            return (committed, False)
248	        if not self.push(remote, branch):
249	            return (committed, False)
250	        if not self._clear_pending_push():
251	            _LOG.error("Push succeeded but pending push reference could not be deleted")
252	            return (committed, False)
253	        return (committed, True)
254	
```

24	    @classmethod
25	    def from_env(cls, env: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None, *, git_runner: Callable[..., subprocess.CompletedProcess] = subprocess.run) -> "AppConfig":
26	        values = os.environ if env is None else env
27	        raw_repo = values.get("REPO_PATH", "").strip()
28	        if not raw_repo: raise ValueError("REPO_PATH is required")
29	        repo = Path(raw_repo).expanduser().resolve()
30	        if not repo.exists() or not repo.is_dir(): raise ValueError(f"REPO_PATH must be an existing directory: {repo}")
31	        def number(name, default, cast=float, positive=False, nonnegative=False):
32	            try: result = cast(values.get(name, str(default)))
33	            except (TypeError, ValueError): raise ValueError(f"{name} must be numeric")
34	            if positive and result <= 0: raise ValueError(f"{name} must be positive")
35	            if nonnegative and result < 0: raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-negative")
36	            return result
37	        timeout = number("GIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", 30.0, float, positive=True)
38	        level = values.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO").strip().upper()
39	        if level not in {"DEBUG", "INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR", "CRITICAL"}: raise ValueError(f"Unsupported log level: {level}")
40	        auto_commit = parse_bool("AUTO_COMMIT", values.get("AUTO_COMMIT", "true"))
41	        auto_push = parse_bool("AUTO_PUSH", values.get("AUTO_PUSH", "true"))
42	        if auto_push and not auto_commit: raise ValueError("AUTO_PUSH requires AUTO_COMMIT")
43	        result = git_runner(["git", "rev-parse", "--is-inside-work-tree"], cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, check=False)
44	        if result.returncode != 0 or result.stdout.strip() != "true": raise ValueError(f"REPO_PATH must be a Git work tree: {repo}")
45	        branch_result = git_runner(["git", "branch", "--show-current"], cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, check=False)
46	        branch = branch_result.stdout.strip()
47	        configured_branch = values.get("GIT_BRANCH", "main").strip()
48	        if not branch: raise ValueError("GIT_BRANCH cannot be used with detached HEAD")
49	        if branch != configured_branch: raise ValueError(f"GIT_BRANCH {configured_branch} does not match checked-out branch {branch}")
50	        things = values.get("THINGSDB", "").strip()
51	        return cls(repo, Path(things).expanduser().resolve() if things else None, level, number("LOG_MAX_BYTES", 10485760, int, positive=True), number("LOG_BACKUP_COUNT", 5, int, nonnegative=True), number("WATCH_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS", 2.0, float, positive=True), number("FULL_SYNC_INTERVAL", 3600.0, float, positive=True), auto_commit, auto_push, values.get("GIT_REMOTE", "origin"), configured_branch, timeout)

1	"""Deterministic Markdown rendering for Things task snapshots."""
2	
3	import re
4	from typing import Sequence
5	
6	from .models import ChecklistItem, TaskSnapshot
7	
8	GENERATED_MARKER = "<!-- generated-by: things3-github-sync; do not edit -->"
9	
10	_STATUS_MARKERS = {
11	    "incomplete": " ",
12	    "completed": "x",
13	    "canceled": "-",
14	}
15	_INLINE_SPECIALS = "\\`*_[]<>"
16	
17	
18	def escape_inline(value: str) -> str:
19	    """Normalize and escape a value that must remain on one Markdown line."""
20	    normalized = value.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
21	    normalized = normalized.replace("\n", " ")
22	    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized).strip()
23	    escaped = []
24	    for character in normalized:
25	        if character in _INLINE_SPECIALS:
26	            escaped.append("\\")
27	        escaped.append(character)
28	    return "".join(escaped)
29	
30	
31	def _status_marker(status: str) -> str:
32	    return _STATUS_MARKERS[status]
33	
34	
35	def _field(label: str, value: str) -> str:
36	    return "- **{}**: {}".format(label, escape_inline(value))
37	
38	
39	def _render_tags(tags: Sequence[str]) -> str:
40	    rendered = []
41	    for tag in tags:
42	        normalized = tag.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
43	        normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", normalized.replace("\n", " ").strip())
44	        rendered.append("#" + escape_inline(normalized))
45	    return " ".join(rendered)
46	
47	
48	def _render_notes(notes: str) -> Sequence[str]:
49	    normalized = notes.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
50	    lines = normalized.split("\n")
51	    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
52	        lines.pop()
53	    if not lines or not any(line.strip() for line in lines):
54	        return ()
55	    return tuple("  " + line for line in lines)
56	
57	
58	def _render_checklist_item(item: ChecklistItem) -> str:
59	    line = "  - [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(item.status), escape_inline(item.title))
60	    if item.stop_date:
61	        line += " — 完成时间: " + escape_inline(item.stop_date)
62	    return line + " <!-- uuid: {} -->".format(item.uuid)
63	
64	
65	def render_task(task: TaskSnapshot) -> str:
66	    """Render one task as a deterministic Markdown block."""
67	    lines = [
68	        "## [{}] {}".format(_status_marker(task.status), escape_inline(task.title)),
69	        "<!-- uuid: {} -->".format(task.uuid),
70	    ]
71	
72	    fields = (
73	        ("创建时间", task.created),
74	        ("修改时间", task.modified),
75	        ("开始日期", task.start_date),
76	        ("截止日期", task.deadline),
77	        ("提醒时间", task.reminder_time),
78	        ("项目", task.project_title),
79	        ("领域", task.area_title),
80	        ("标题分组", task.heading_title),
81	    )
82	    lines.extend(_field(label, value) for label, value in fields if value)
83	
84	    if task.tags:
85	        lines.append("- **标签**: " + _render_tags(task.tags))
86	
87	    note_lines = _render_notes(task.notes) if task.notes else ()
88	    if note_lines:
89	        lines.append("- **备注**:")
90	        lines.extend(note_lines)
91	
92	    if task.checklist:
93	        lines.append("- **子任务**:")
94	        lines.extend(_render_checklist_item(item) for item in task.checklist)
95	
96	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
97	
98	
99	def render_document(title: str, tasks: Sequence[TaskSnapshot]) -> str:
100	    """Render a managed Markdown document containing task blocks."""
101	    header = "{}\n# {}\n".format(GENERATED_MARKER, escape_inline(title))
102	    if not tasks:
103	        return header
104	
105	    blocks = [render_task(task).rstrip("\n") for task in tasks]
106	    return header + "\n" + "\n---\n".join(blocks) + "\n---\n"
107	
108	
109	def is_managed_markdown(content: str) -> bool:
110	    """Return whether the first line is the exact generated marker."""
111	    first_line = content.splitlines()[0] if content.splitlines() else ""
112	    return first_line == GENERATED_MARKER

1	"""Pure, deterministic rendering of Things snapshots into Markdown documents."""
2	
3	import logging
4	from pathlib import Path
5	from typing import Dict, Iterable, List, Sequence, Set, Tuple
6	
7	from .markdown import render_document
8	from .models import ContainerPath, ContainerSnapshot, RenderedSnapshot, TaskSnapshot, ThingsSnapshot
9	from .utils import sanitize_path_segment
10	
11	
12	_LOG = logging.getLogger(__name__)
13	_ROOT_FILES = (
14	    (Path("Inbox.md"), "Inbox"),
15	    (Path("Today.md"), "Today"),
16	    (Path("Anytime.md"), "Anytime"),
17	    (Path("Someday.md"), "Someday"),
18	    (Path("Upcoming.md"), "Upcoming"),
19	    (Path("已完成.md"), "已完成"),
20	    (Path("已取消.md"), "已取消"),
21	)
22	_CONTAINER_FILES = (
23	    ("tasks.md", "任务"),
24	    ("已完成.md", "已完成"),
25	    ("已取消.md", "已取消"),
26	)
27	_VALID_STARTS = {"Inbox", "Anytime", "Someday"}
28	_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH = 120
29	
30	
31	def _container_sort_key(container: ContainerSnapshot) -> Tuple[str, str]:
32	    return (container.title.casefold(), container.uuid)
33	
34	
35	def _uuid_token(uuid: str) -> str:
36	    """Return a deterministic, one-segment-safe representation of a UUID."""
37	    token = []
38	    for character in uuid:
39	        if character.isascii() and (character.isalnum() or character in "-_"):
40	            token.append(character)
41	        else:
42	            token.extend("x{:02x}".format(byte) for byte in character.encode("utf-8"))
43	    return "".join(token) or "uuid"
44	
45	
46	def _suffix_segment(base: str, uuid: str, length: int, ordinal: int = 0) -> str:
47	    suffix = "-" + _uuid_token(uuid)[:length]
48	    if ordinal:
49	        suffix += "-" + str(ordinal)
50	    available = _MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH - len(suffix)
51	    if available <= 0:
52	        return suffix[-_MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH:]
53	    return base[:available].rstrip(".").strip() + suffix
54	
55	
56	def _unique_suffix_lengths(containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], needs_suffix: Set[str]) -> Dict[str, int]:
57	    """Return UUID prefix lengths that distinguish suffixed peers."""
58	    lengths = {
59	        container.uuid: min(8, len(_uuid_token(container.uuid)))
60	        for container in containers
61	        if container.uuid in needs_suffix
62	    }
63	    while True:
64	        groups: Dict[Tuple[str, str], List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
65	        for container in containers:
66	            if container.uuid not in needs_suffix:
67	                continue
68	            token = _uuid_token(container.uuid)
69	            key = (bases[container.uuid].casefold(), token[:lengths[container.uuid]].casefold())
70	            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(container)
71	        duplicates = [group for group in groups.values() if len(group) > 1]
72	        if not duplicates:
73	            return lengths
74	        changed = False
75	        for group in duplicates:
76	            for container in group:
77	                current = lengths[container.uuid]
78	                token = _uuid_token(container.uuid)
79	                if current < len(token):
80	                    lengths[container.uuid] = current + 1
81	                    changed = True
82	        if not changed:
83	            # UUIDs are unique, so this is defensive only for non-standard inputs.
84	            return lengths
85	
86	
87	def _collision_ordinals(
88	    containers: Sequence[ContainerSnapshot], bases: Dict[str, str], lengths: Dict[str, int], needs_suffix: Set[str]
89	) -> Dict[str, int]:
90	    """Assign stable ordinal suffixes to residual case-insensitive collisions."""
91	    candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
92	    for container in containers:
93	        segment = (
94	            _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
95	            if container.uuid in needs_suffix
96	            else bases[container.uuid]
97	        )
98	        candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
99	
100	    ordinals: Dict[str, int] = {}
101	    for group in candidates.values():
102	        if len(group) > 1:
103	            for ordinal, container in enumerate(sorted(group, key=_container_sort_key), start=1):
104	                ordinals[container.uuid] = ordinal
105	    return ordinals
106	
107	
108	def _allocate_kind(containers: Iterable[ContainerSnapshot], kind: str, root: str) -> List[ContainerPath]:
109	    active = sorted(
110	        (container for container in containers if not container.trashed),
111	        key=_container_sort_key,
112	    )
113	    bases = {
114	        container.uuid: sanitize_path_segment(
115	            container.title, "{}-{}".format(kind, _uuid_token(container.uuid)[:8])
116	        )
117	        for container in active
118	    }
119	    needs_suffix: Set[str] = set()
120	
121	    # A case-insensitive duplicate cannot retain either clean segment.
122	    by_clean_name: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
123	    for container in active:
124	        by_clean_name.setdefault(bases[container.uuid].casefold(), []).append(container)
125	    for group in by_clean_name.values():
126	        if len(group) > 1:
127	            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
128	
129	    # A generated suffix can naturally be another container title.  Mark every
130	    # conflicting path for suffixing, then repeat until all candidates are unique.
131	    while True:
132	        lengths = _unique_suffix_lengths(active, bases, needs_suffix)
133	        candidates: Dict[str, List[ContainerSnapshot]] = {}
134	        for container in active:
135	            segment = (
136	                _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid])
137	                if container.uuid in needs_suffix
138	                else bases[container.uuid]
139	            )
140	            candidates.setdefault(segment.casefold(), []).append(container)
141	        conflicts = [group for group in candidates.values() if len(group) > 1]
142	        if not conflicts:
143	            break
144	        previous_count = len(needs_suffix)
145	        for group in conflicts:
146	            needs_suffix.update(container.uuid for container in group)
147	        if len(needs_suffix) == previous_count:
148	            break
149	
150	    ordinals = _collision_ordinals(active, bases, lengths, needs_suffix)
151	    paths = []
152	    used_segments: Set[str] = set()
153	    for container in active:
154	        if container.uuid in needs_suffix:
155	            ordinal = ordinals.get(container.uuid, 0)
156	            segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
157	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
158	                ordinal += 1
159	                segment = _suffix_segment(bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, lengths[container.uuid], ordinal)
160	        else:
161	            segment = bases[container.uuid]
162	            ordinal = 0
163	            while segment.casefold() in used_segments:
164	                ordinal += 1
165	                segment = _suffix_segment(
166	                    bases[container.uuid], container.uuid, len(_uuid_token(container.uuid)), ordinal
167	                )
168	        used_segments.add(segment.casefold())
169	        paths.append(ContainerPath(container.uuid, kind, Path(root) / segment))
170	    return paths
171

200	def _primary_file(

235	def render_snapshot(snapshot: ThingsSnapshot) -> RenderedSnapshot:
236	    """Render an immutable, entirely in-memory representation of a snapshot."""
237	    containers = allocate_container_paths(snapshot.projects, snapshot.areas)
238	    project_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "project"}
239	    area_paths = {item.uuid: item.relative_dir for item in containers if item.kind == "area"}

243	    titles: Dict[Path, str] = {path: title for path, title in _ROOT_FILES}
244	    for container in containers:
245	        for filename, suffix in _CONTAINER_FILES:
246	            path = container.relative_dir / filename
247	            tasks_by_file[path] = []
248	            titles[path] = _document_title(path, suffix)
249	
250	    for task in active_tasks:
251	        tasks_by_file[_primary_file(task, project_paths, area_paths)].append(task)
252	
253	    for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items():
254	        if path.name in {"已完成.md", "已取消.md"}:
255	            tasks.sort(key=_terminal_sort_key)
256	        else:
257	            tasks.sort(key=_primary_sort_key)
258	
259	    active_by_uuid = {task.uuid: task for task in active_tasks}
260	    warned_missing: Set[str] = set()
261	    tasks_by_file[Path("Today.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.today_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
262	    tasks_by_file[Path("Upcoming.md")] = _dynamic_tasks(snapshot.upcoming_uuids, active_by_uuid, warned_missing)
263	
264	    files = {path: render_document(titles[path], tasks) for path, tasks in tasks_by_file.items()}
265	    return RenderedSnapshot(files=files, containers=containers)
266	
```
